Name: Immunological Biotechnology, Aarhus University

Research
Immunological biotechnology represents a strategy for dissecting and manipulating molecular processes in health and disease and is crucial for development and optimisation of proteins for therapeutic intervention as well as diagnostics.

Central for our research is the molecular access to the disease and a  mechanism-driven development of biologicals at the interface of immunology, protein biochemistry, biotechnology, and chemistry. Within this concept the specific needs for patient tailored, precision medical treatment are addressed.

The understanding of molecular functions, structures and interactions enables the design of biologicals and offers novel opportunities for shaping of immune responses.

Specific research interests and projects primarily focus on molecular immunology in research, diagnostics and therapy:

Immune repertoires and combinatorial technologies

Immunoglobulins: isotypes, functions, targeting

Molecular allergology

Molecular recognition in health and disease

Nanobody technologies for diagnostics and intervention

Protein engineering and production

Name: MycoTeQ A/S
Description:
Discovery and Development of novel antibiotics
All around the world a growing number of resistant bacteria create health problems in the hospital sector. At MycoTeQ we work to discover and develop novel natural antibiotics from microfungi. New effective antibiotics are needed in order to be able to combat the multiresistant bacteria that jeopardize the health of hospitalized patients today and in the future.

Microfungal Library
We have access to a microfungal library that contains more than 30,000 unique strains of microfungi. All of them are classified according to the metabolites they produce in comprehensive databases. We screen the microfungal collection for interesting production patterns and compound similarities – hereby enabling a fast selection of strains that produces unknown metabolites of special interest towards a given disease.

Gene Targeting
Genes encoding production of secondary metabolites are naturally arranged in certain constellations in the microfungal genome. At MycoTeQ we have developed state-of-the-art methods for identifying these gene clusters. This allows us to rearrange important genes and up- or down-regulate the expression of key genes. Hereby we can control the production fingerprint of microfungi and develop high yielding strains. We also work with highly optimized microfungal cell factories that allow us to develop production strains suited for scale up.

Focus on Fungi
In collaboration with our partners we test efficacy and toxicity of promising new compounds. MycoTeQ does not proceed beyond clinical phase I – we keep a narrow focus on what we are best at: The world of microfungi.

Focusing on wheat (Triticum aestivum)—one of the world’s most important cereal crops—MATRIX investigates the phyllosphere microbiome (the microbial communities on and within leaf tissues), with a particular emphasis on the flag leaf, a major determinant of wheat yield (up to 45%).

Bringing together leading expertise in microbiology, chemistry, DNA/RNA sequencing, bioinformatics, machine learning, and crop modelling, MATRIX combines cutting-edge research with industry support in plant breeding and agronomy to develop novel approaches for sustainable agriculture.

Key Objectives:
 Mapping the Wheat Flag Leaf Microbiome – A comprehensive taxonomy and functional catalogue
 Microbial Repository Development – Identification and characterization of key microbial taxa
 Metabolome Profiling – Chemical and volatile compound analysis in the phyllosphere
 AI-Powered Crop Resilience Models – Deep-learning approaches for microbiome prediction
 Biotechnological Applications – Developing scalable microbial interventions for crop improvement

MATRIX is led by Lars Hestbjerg Hansen at PLEN, University of Copenhagen], in collaboration with research partners from UCPH, DTU, NIOO and NCSU across Denmark, Netherlands and the US.

Name: Illum Biotech
Description:
GPCR activation was historically viewed as a simple transition from one inactive to one active state. In reality, during activation, GPCRs progress through multiple conformational intermediates, which are rate-limiting and pharmacologically decisive.
Rational drug design, therefore, requires more than knowledge of endpoint function or endpoint structure. It requires linking ligand chemotype to all individual conformational intermediates that determine receptor activation.
Conformational Sequencing (ConfoSeq) is the first high-throughput platform to resolve structure-activity relationships across discrete receptor activation intermediates. By making those hidden states experimentally accessible at scale, ConfoSeq achieves drug discovery’s longest-sought ambition: the deterministic design of pharmacology.

The company was founded in response to an identified need for specialist knowledge in especially small and medium sized biotech companies, which cannot necessarily afford to permanently employ the plethora of specialists required to properly address the multifaceted discipline of running a state-of-the-art in vivo facility, without removing valuable resources from their primary business objective.

At the core of our business concept is a wish to continuously improve animal welfare and the quality of in vivo research through application of science, technology and best practices – to the benefit of the animal resource, our clients, and the scientific community in general.

Name: BioFrontiers
Description:
BioFrontiers is a dynamically developing non-profit organisation chartered by a group of life science academics and professionals based in the Copenhagen area. Inspired by the internationally recognised start-up scene, research excellence as well as entrepreneur-friendly environment in Denmark, we decided to use our expertise to accelerate the bilateral collaboration between Denmark and Poland.

As young professionals integrated in the Danish research sector and the biotech industry, we are well positioned to stimulate successful international collaboration. Many BioFrontiers members have extensive experience spanning across multiple countries and continents. This gives us a unique perspective on the important aspects of project management and innovation incubation in diverse environments. By actively participating in and organising new initiatives, we hope to facilitate the exchange of ideas for entrepreneurship and application-oriented research in both academia and industry.

Name: CeOx ApS
Description:
CeOx ApS is a startup specializing in the development of innovative micropumps for drug delivery and microfluidic applications. We aim to revolutionize the way drugs are delivered to patients through our innovative and precise micropump technology based on electrostrictor functional materials.
Our novel pumps are designed to be compact, reliable, and easy to integrate, and they offer precise control over the flow rate and volume of fluids. CeOx micropumps have the potential to improve patient outcomes and increase the efficiency and accuracy of drug delivery and microfluidic actuation in a variety of settings.

Name: CleanShield Group
Description:
CleanShield Group

100% Natural & 100% biodegradable products for the Agriculture-, Biosecurity,  Healthcare-, Cleaning- & Hospitality-sector. 
Elimination of all bacteria 99,99% and adding strength to crops & plants. 

With our 7 unique pioneering and green products, we are changing the world while taking care of the environment. 

We are a Danish-based company that has been around for more than 15 years. With our completely green profile, we create tomorrow's green solutions in many industries.

Name: Valicentra
Description:
Valicentra is a microbiological CRO focused on testing of biologicals, with particular expertise in plant protection products, Bacillus-based formulations and CFU-based methods.

We are establishing a laboratory and GLP framework designed specifically for biologicals, with a strong emphasis on scientifically sound, fit-for-purpose testing strategies and the generation of reliable, regulatory-defensible data.

Our services will cover both GLP and non-GLP studies, including Certificates of Analysis (CoA), method development and validation, stability studies, QC testing, residue studies, contamination testing, 5-batch studies, and scientific consultancy.

During our founding phase, we are engaging with industry partners to better understand current challenges in microbiological testing and regulatory studies, ensuring that our setup reflects real-world needs.

Interested in early collaboration or pilot studies? We welcome the opportunity to discuss how we can support your upcoming projects.

E-mail : contact@valicentra.com

Name: VetCur Biotec
Description:
VetCur is the leading authority and innovative biotechnological partner, developing tailored species specific diets for animals, worldwide.

Through our inspiration by nature and the power of science, we are obligated to set up new feeding standards for the planet as a whole and animals in particular. 

The millions of years in which nature and all living organisms have evolved, an enormous potential for technological innovation has been provided by nature itself. Roughly only about 12% of the potential knowledge available is used to develop new products, and create innovative solutions. VetCur is successfully tapping into the wast yet unharvested technological potential, creating innovative health solutions for animals, by integrating productivity, sustainability, biological adequacy, animal wellfare and environmental care. 

In summary our three values are:

    * Innovation
    * Responsibility
    * Sustainable growth.

Name: 1Health Gut In Balance APS
Description:
1Health Gut In Balance APS is a leading healthcare company, founded in 2018 and headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. Our purpose is to drive innovative therapy to defeat chronic diseases linked to gut dysbiosis/ unbalance gut microbiota. 
By using our innovative products, such as patented gut microbiota transplantation capsules, we enable transplanting healthy gut environments to promote gut microbiota symbiosis in patients. This enables effective patient therapy and improvement of patient quality of life.
For more detail and information please write to: hcl@gut-in-balance.dk

Name: CPT.one Biotech
Description:
CPT.one Biotech is a privately funded Danish biotech company, dedicated to the development of novel treatments primarily for patients suffering from secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (SP-MS).

CPT-001 is partly in-licensed and further developed by CPT.one Biotech and has a first in class mode of action and block lipid transport in the mitochondria and thereby regulate fat and glucose metabolism. The target is mitochondrial CPT1 and the treatment reestablishes defectives in myelin sheets.

CPT.one welcomes enquiries regarding partnering opportunities.

Name: PureTech ApS
Description: Optimer hygiejnen under hensyn til arbejdsmiljø og sundhed, samtidig med at du får en effektiv rengøring med 100% bionedbrydelige rengøringsmidler.

Name: DeTectUs
Description: DeTectUs is a student team that participates in the SensUs Student Competition each year where the team develops innovative biosensing systems.

Name: Capteria
Description: We manufacture see-through glass sculptures containing cyanobacteria. Due to the potential of the cells, our cylinders are carbon-negative, sustainable and they help you stay on track with your ESG measurements.

Name: CarboNcare
Description:
CarboNcare is working on new biological manufacturing systems where microbial growth, product formation and process stability are linked together. The project looks at how future bioprocesses can become more stable, more efficient, and better at keeping carbon in valuable products. It does this by using renewable methanol as a sustainable carbon source for valuable chemicals.

Funded by the European Innovation Council Pathfinder programme under grant agreement 101258189, CarboNcare brings together leading European researchers and innovators to explore a new vision for manufacturing that uses carbon more efficiently.

Views and opinions expressed are however those of the authors only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Innovation Council. Neither the European Union nor the granting authority can be held responsible for them.

Account managed by INsociety (IN SRL)

Name: Bojesen and Petersen Biotech
Description:
bActivate finds the infection swabs miss. A standard uterine swab detects only 34% of infected mares. bActivate reactivates dormant Streptococcus zooepidemicus in the equine uterus so the infection becomes detectable by standard culture and the veterinarian can treat it. Peer-reviewed in Veterinary Microbiology (2015). Developed at the University of Copenhagen.
bActivate has been developed by two Danish researchers following their discovery that up to 10% of all mares may have subclinical uterine infections and the adverse impact of such infections on mare fertility. 

Veterinarians at the world’s largest equine hospital in Kentucky have demonstrated that bActivate virtually restored the live-foal rates to normal and thus re-vitalized mares that had been given up for breeding. If you are interested in the scientific data concerning bActivate, please visit our website.

Name: Biologigaragen
Description:
Biologigaragen is a community of researchers, makers, designers and artists who are bound by a passion for the wet-sciences. With interests ranging from microbiology to microfluidics, biometrics to biomaterials and much more, we are a diverse group located close to the center of Copenhagen, Denmark. 

We believe in supporting grassroots level innovation in biosciences and knowledge dissemination to the broader community.

Name: UniqAir
Description:
UniqAir er en finsk cleantech virksomhed, der fremstiller og leverer specialudviklede systemer til den offentlige og private sektor. UniqAir’s system har verdens mest effektive sundhedsfiltre og er testet af Teknologisk Institut i Aarhus, VTT (Finlands Teknologiske Institut) og TTL (Finlands Arbejdssundhedsinstitut). UniqAir’s filtre fjerner 99.9% af synlige og usynlige
partikler samt 100% af forurenende luftarter. UniqAir leverer effektiv og hurtig hjælp ved indeklimaproblemer i kommuner,
regioner, social- og sundhedspleje, uddannelsesinstitutioner og virksomheder. Læs mere på www.uniqair.dk

Name: AuroDerm
Description: AuroDerm has developed a patent-pending technology, adding micron-sized pure metallic gold implants to soft tissue fillers, to maximize safety and stability and minimizing the risk of side effects.

Name: Buhloncology
Description:
Buhloncology develops anticancer drugs and provides strategic and operational leadership.

Buhloncology works on a pipeline of promising drugs, bridging from science to clincial development, from scientists to investors and from idea to commercialisation.

Name: Nordic Vaccine A/S
Description:
Nordic Vaccine A/S is a vaccine research and development company, with focus on the development and commercialization of new vaccines for prophylactic and therapeutic use. 

The company's development program is based on its proprietary immune stimulating nano-particles, PosintroTM, that combines safe and efficient delivery of vaccines with optimal immune responses.

Besides traditional injection, the unique features of these nanoparticles enable various forms of needle-free delivery, as applied in a new vaccine patch system: TransVacTM.

Name: RIID
Description:
At RIID we are developing a SaaS online platform to help companies and institutions to focus on the scientific and practical applications of affordable genome and other large data set analyses and let us take care of the underlying software requirements. 

We have created RIID, a fast and user-friendly scientific data analyzing platform, which allows everyone, non-experts included, to analyze genetic data. Our alignment tools are compatible with portable devices and big data sets. We provide a large storage space, swift genome data transfer (e.g. Dropbox, Google drive, USB...), customizable analysis pipelines, reports and graphs.

Moreover, our platform can be tailored to our customers’ needs within four areas: 
1.) rapid data acquisition and management 
2.) data filtering, processing and analysis 
3.) team management and data sharing 
4.) results visualization and reporting 

Our mission
Genome sequencing and analysis used to be costly and time consuming, and the sequencing devices often filled up entire rooms and were only available to experts in large institutions. However, this is rapidly changing and the size and price of the hardware is dropping drastically, opening up for a large number of applications and projects that were impossible and unimaginable just a few years ago. The transformational development is on its way in the sequencing field, and RiiD is part of the next generation of projects, products and services. 

Our offer
We are actively searching for partners with relevant projects that put our platform through its paces. Feel free to contact us for an informal chat about your needs. We offer solutions for efficient data analysis tailored to your needs. Whether it is genomics or another application field, we provide a flexible platform and user–friendly interface for data handling.

Name: Nordic - American Health Investor Network
Description:
The Nordic - American Health Investor Network is a network of leading Nordic and North American life science and health investors with a shared commitment to creating transatlantic investment opportunities and accelerating the impact of life science and health innovation across the Atlantic and beyond.

The initiative is facilitated by Innovation Centre Denmark, Invest in Denmark, Innovation Norway and other partners.

Name: Amphidex A/S
Description:
Amphidex is a Danish company founded in early 2010 by Aalborg University and NOVI Innovation A/S. The main idea and background behind the company’s patent, has been developed by researchers at Aalborg University’s Supramolecular Chemistry Group, amongst these Dr. Kim Lambertsen Larsen, from the Cyclodextrin group of the Department of Chemistry at Aalborg University. This cyclodextrin group has researched various areas of cyclodextrin chemistry and applications for more than 10 years. At present, the group consist of two assistant professors, one associate professor, four PhD students, which are directly linked to Amphidex A/S.

The work of the group has led to unique applications of the cyclodextrins and numerous publications. One of the applications is this new, patented coating technology with the amphiphilic cyclodextrins which is handled by Amphidex A/S. Another application is the patented technology of creating channel cyclodextrins from native CD’s utilizing our own laboratory protocols. The channel cyclodextrins (CCDs) many-fold the uptake of VOC’s compared to native cage cyclodextrins and can hence be utilized in numerous new areas where enlarged capacity is desired.

Name: Wiborg Aps
Description:
Wiborg ApS is a leading Scandinavian consultancy firm providing strategic advice and business development services to companies and research institutions working in the biotech & life science field. 

Our key competence is to combine in-depth industry, technology and market analyses with commercial valuation and licensing of drugs, diagnostics and devices. We have particular expertise within therapeutic areas such as oncology, inflammation, metabolic and infectious diseases and utilize our large global networks of relevant medical experts and industry contacts.

Name: Soren Ottosen Innovation
Description:
Soren Ottosen Innovation offers expert consulting for new or established biotech, pharma, investors or any other entity with emerging interests in the nucleic acid based medicines market.

We offer consultation on strategy, portfolio and project execution for early projects within the field of nucleic acid based medicines.

We offer business evaluation of nucleic acid opportunities for investors and start-ups companies.

We offer consultation for early biotech seeking to professionalize company practices, staff and vendor interactions.

Name: AquaTerra Biosolutions
Description:
At AquaTerra Biosolutions, we develop advanced microbial technologies that make water, waste, and agricultural systems more efficient, stable, and sustainable.

Our solutions are based on natural, non-GMO bacteria, carefully selected for their ability to break down organic matter, neutralize harmful byproducts, and restore microbial balance in complex environments — all without chemicals.

Through bioaugmentation, we introduce tailored bacterial cultures and automated dosing systems that adapt to each client’s system. These beneficial microbes enhance biological performance, suppress harmful organisms, and transform pollutants like fats, ammonia, and hydrogen sulfide into harmless byproducts such as water, carbon dioxide, and nitrogen.

 What We Do

Our microbial platforms are applied across key sectors:

Wastewater & Biogas – Improve biological stability, reduce sludge, odor, and corrosion, and lower chemical use.

Aquaculture (RAS & ponds) – Enhance water quality, reduce ammonia and sludge, and promote healthy aquatic environments.

Agriculture & Soil Health – Strengthen soil microbiomes, improve nutrient uptake, and increase plant resilience and yield.

Infrastructure & Pumping Stations – Prevent fat build-up, corrosion, and odor while reducing maintenance and extending system life.

Surface Water & Lakes – Break down sludge, reduce nutrient overload, and prevent algae blooms for cleaner, clearer ecosystems.

Our goal is simple: to help industries, municipalities, and farmers reduce their environmental footprint and operational costs through smart biotechnology that works in real-world conditions.

 AquaTerra Biosolutions – bridging biotechnology and sustainability to create cleaner water, healthier soil, and a more balanced environment.

Name: Aneeva Ltd. Business Acceleration in Europe
Description:
Do you want to establish or increase sales in North Europe?

Are you scouting for technologies?

Or maybe you are looking for assistance with you research grant application?

Do your company need distributors in Germany, Scandinavia, Finland, Baltic, Poland or Israel?

Visit www.aneeva.com to learn more.

Name: Dalea
Description: Dalea is a next-generation research orchestration platform. Notebooks, data management, inventory, results, and AI. Unified in a single collaborative workspace. No more silos. No more isolated spreadsheets.

Name: SPZ Lab
Description:
SPZ Lab helps couples – and especially the man – improve their fertility. The laboratory is using an SDI-test to analyse sperm DNA integrity to find reasons for miscarriage.

The SDI-test can help you ensure a successful fertility treatment. It should therefore be done as early as possible in your course of treatments.

SPZ Lab is a diagnostic laboratory founded in 2006 by Preben Christiansen and Anders Birck. Both are educated as Veterinarians and Ph.D. and have been involved in research for many years. SPZ Lab offers an examination of cell DNA integrity, the SDI-test, to European fertility specialists and clinics, and their patients. SPZ Lab is also involved in fertility research and has a special interest in the underlying causes of cell DNA fragility.

Name: Concepteq
Description: Concepteq is a Danish health care company focusing on personalized supplement. We believe that one-size-fits-all approaches to health are a thing of the past. Our mission is to empower individuals to take control of their well-being by providing tailored nutritional solutions that cater to their unique needs and goals. We aim to develop a cutting-edge platform that leverages on the latest advancements in science and technology to create personalized supplement regimens that consider individual need, lifestyle, and health objectives.

Name: Wheat alliance
Description:
The Wheat Alliance represents a strategic international partnership dedicated to advancing wheat research and sustainable agricultural innovation. This collaborative initiative combines extensive genetic resources, established relationships with commercial breeding companies, and deep expertise across multiple scientific disciplines including wheat genetics, advanced phenotyping technologies, crop modeling, and plant-microbe symbiosis research.

Our consortium brings together leading researchers from the Collaborative Crop Resilience Program (CCRP), which includes scientists from Aarhus University, University of Copenhagen, Utrecht University, and North Carolina State University. We are further strengthened by partnerships with the Crop Science Centre (CSC) and the National Institute of Agricultural Botany (NIAB), creating a comprehensive research network that spans multiple continents and combines diverse scientific perspectives.

Our ultimate goal is to enhance crop breeding strategies and advance sustainable agricultural practices that can meet global food security challenges while reducing environmental impact.

By integrating cutting-edge research with practical agricultural applications, we aim to bridge the gap between laboratory discoveries and field implementation. Our work focuses on understanding and optimizing the complex relationships between wheat plants and beneficial soil microorganisms, particularly those that enhance nutrient acquisition and improve crop resilience.

Name: qbiom
Description:
At Qbiom, our mission is to empower pharma/biotech companies to efficiently conduct, analyze and interpret microbiome studies. Our approach is grounded in customized approaches, using state-of-the-art probabilistic AI metholodoliges 

We feed our cutting-edge deep probabilistic framework with your domain knowledge expertise in the field of microbiology, medicine, and biotechnology bringing you closer to your goal.

  - We design and conduct experiments together with clients to answer various microbiome questions related to their business objectives. To answer these questions, we use multiple omics technologies and advanced analytics
   - We apply the state-of-the-art data processing methods. We tailor our data analysis pipeline with customer's data files and adapt our models are tailored towards their experiments.
   - We use advanced multivariate data analyses to sort out peptide, compound, protein candidates, identify biomarkers, elucidate mode-of-action, characterize products and processes and predict behavior.

Name: OligoMaker ApS
Description:
OligoMaker offers state-of-the-art DNA and RNA synthesizers trusted by laboratories worldwide. Our decades of knowledge ensure we deliver precision synthesizers that enhance productivity and enable groundbreaking research.

OligoMaker ApS is a company based out of København, Denmark.

Name: NERD - Neuro Ecological Research Denmark
Description:
NERD is an independent basic research organisation specialised in the interdisciplinary field of neuroecology and stereology.
Neuro Ecological Research Denmark (NERD) IVS was founded in April 2016. NERD is managed by three researchers: Sophie Wiese, Esther Kjær Needham and Mikkel Vestergaard Olesen.  Through our unique combination of scientific expertise and creative and educational experience, we wish to create an independent basic research institute based on sustainable and curiousity driven research

Stereology services – a foundation for self-financed research
NERD provides services within histology and stereology through our collaboration with the Research Laboratory for Stereology and Neuroscience, which is the world leading laboratory within neurostereological research. From these commercial activities we have created a foundation for self-financing our basic research.

Stop Brain Waste – promoting tissue sharing
NERD has also established the NERD Animal Brain Bank, where animal brain tissue is stored as part of our Stop Brain Waste concept, promoting sustainable research through tissue sharing.

Name: Prisma EU Project
Description: PRISMA is a revolutionary thin flm micropump which can be used as an innovative pumping system in wearable insulin delivery devices for the treatment of diabetes. The long-term goal is to allow the realization of multi-drug delivery systems, making real the much-lauded multi-hormone treatment.

Name: Jutelink
Description: Jutelink is a Denmark-based biotechnology startup working with fibre-based biopolymer for sustainable packaging. Our mission is to replace conventional plastics with plant-based alternatives that support Denmark’s leadership in biosolutions.

Name: Nensius Research A/S
Description: Nensius Research A/S is a Danish-based biotech company with a well defined focus on preclinical research within neurodegenerative diseases of the central nervous system. Our mission is to design pharmacologically active compounds which act on a range of therapeutic targets aimed at treating and reversing the pathology of neurodegenerative diseases.

Name: Dermelior
Description:
Dermelior is developing a next-generation dermal patch for the treatment of mild-to-moderate psoriasis.

Current topical therapies are limited by poor patient adherence, inconvenient application, and low drug penetration into the skin. As a result, many patients remain undertreated despite available medications.

Our technology replaces traditional creams and ointments with a thin, flexible patch engineered for sustained drug delivery over multiple days. By improving adherence, comfort, and therapeutic efficiency, Dermelior aims to enhance treatment outcomes while reducing disease burden.

Built on electrospun nanofiber technology, our platform enables tunable, controlled release of active compounds and improved delivery to target skin layers.

Our vision is to redefine topical treatment by combining advanced drug delivery with patient-centric design.

Follow along for updates on our journey!

Name: Wellcrop Europe
Description:
WellCrop Europe are a microbial technology company developing microbial crop solutions for the agricultural industry. We identify the optimal collection of microbes and nutrients to produce high quality inputs and crop care products, creating sustainable farming practices, as well as helping the environment.

All of our products are produced under strictly controlled parameters, in collaboration with a team of highly qualified scientists.

Currently farmers rely on traditional chemical fertilizers which are expensive, inefficient logistically and have adverse long term effects on yields, soils and the environment. With an estimated 9 billion global population by 2050, the world needs a climate smart alternative which allows farmers to grow more and grow sustainable.

WellCrop Europe helps farmers realize the potential of carbon sequestration in soils, the realization of turning world soils into sinks for atmospheric CO2. 

Storing the carbon contained in organic matter within the soil is one way to mitigate climate change by reducing greenhouse gas emissions (in this case carbon dioxide). 

As freight transport - whether by air, land or sea - relies heavily on fossil fuel for propulsion and is still a long way from being able to switch to cleaner energy sources, it is one of the hardest sectors to de-carbonize.
We reduce the footprint for the Agricultural sector by replacing heavy, bulky inorganic additives traditionally used in both organic and inorganic agriculture with our lightweight product. 

Please contact us if you want to contribute to our common goal - taking care of our globe.

Name: Scandidact Aps - Bioscience
Description:
Welcome to Scandidact Aps - Bioscience
- This Linkedin page is primary for the bioscience target group. We will In general  focus on bringing relevant material in form of new products and projects from the Scandidact bioscience section/webshop.
___

Name: BiotechPRO
Description:

BiotechPRO assists with technological design, engineering, managing and implementation of technological solutions within biomass and energy. Model based predictions and simulation, assessments and technology evaluations.

Finally, we offer advice on IPR with respect to commercial exploitation.

Name: StatGroup ApS
Description:
We have a long experience working with biostatistics in the biopharmaceutical industry covering all phases from early research to commercialization. For more than a decade, StatGroup has provided statistical expertise to companies ranging from small pre-clinical biotech to some of the largest pharma companies with global presence.

 Input to or review of CDPs, Submissions, Protocols, or SAPs
 CRO oversight of Stats and DM
 An internal Statistical Expert
 Publication support
 Data visualization and analysis of research data

Name: Micromedic aps
Description:
We aim to be the leading competence-driven supplier in our field — trusted by customers and respected in the industry.

Understand and meet your needs and expectations

Continuously improve our operations through dedication and professionalism

Safety and a healthy work environment

Clear governance and continuous follow-up

Name: Valinor ApS
Description:
Valinor ApS is a Copenhagen-based biotech startup pioneering the development of an innovative platform for the production of individualized cancer therapies.

Every cancer is unique, as every cancer arises from the accumulation of numerous genetic mutations, often tens to hundreds of thousands per tumor. Yet, current treatments do not exploit this vast majority of targets. Valinor's patented treatment can, with ultra-high precision, target cancer cells at their core, introducing lethal DNA double-strand breaks exclusively in the cancer cells. This approach is akin to the cell-killing mechanism of radiation therapy (DNA breakage) but with unparalleled precision – only tumor cell DNA is lethally damaged, sparing all normal cells.

Valinor’s pipeline identifies cancer-specific DNA targets in the patient’s tumor genome, enabling AI-assisted bioinformatics target selection, CRISPR/Cas engineering, and drug product nanoparticle assembly for the customized cancer treatment tailored to the individual case.

Name: Agilent Technologies
Description:
Agilent customers are finding new ways to treat cancer, ensure food, water, air, and medicine quality and safety, discover new drug treatments, research infectious diseases, and create alternative energy solutions for a greener planet. From start to finish, we have them covered with our vast product solutions and services portfolio.

Around the world, Agilent’s people bring innovations, technologies, and services to the forefront of science. Our teams design and manufacture a wide array of advanced analytical, research, and diagnostic solutions and tools for use inside and outside laboratories.

Additionally, the unique expertise of Agilent’s CrossLab and technical teams provides valuable insight and support to our customers, helping them fully optimize their laboratories and resources to better focus on what's important: bringing great science to life.

In fiscal 2022, Agilent Technologies generated revenue of (US) $6.85 billion.

Name: Bio-Rad Laboratories
Description: Bio-Rad provides the healthcare industry with innovative and useful products that help life science researchers accelerate the discovery process and medical diagnostic labs obtain faster, better results. For more than 70 years we have built long-lasting customer relationships that help advance our research and development efforts in the introduction of new products and solutions. Today, Bio-Rad is a global leader, with a team of almost 8,000 employees and a network of operations that serves our life science research and clinical diagnostics customers, advancing science and saving lives, together.

Name: QIAGEN
Description:
Making improvements in life possible is more than our vision. It is the reason QIAGEN exists.
 
From combating cancer and diagnosing infectious diseases to keeping food and communities safe, the world's most urgent challenges begin with unlocking the insights hidden in DNA and RNA, the building blocks of life. That is where we come in.
 
We are QIAGEN, a Netherlands-based global leader in Sample to Insight solutions. Our technologies isolate and process DNA, RNA and proteins, prepare them for analysis, and turn complex molecular data into clear, actionable insights. Automation brings it together into seamless workflows for the Life Sciences (academia, pharmaceutical R&D and industrial applications such as forensics) and Molecular Diagnostics for clinical healthcare.
 
Every day, more than 500,000 customers around the world rely on us to extract meaning from genetic material quickly, confidently and accurately, from young scientists and pharma R&D teams to clinical labs and more than 35 Nobel Prize winners.
 
Behind it all are the QIAGENers, more than 5,000 colleagues across 75 nationalities and subsidiaries in 25 countries, united by the three promises in our name: Quality, Ingenuity and Accessibility.
 
We are a partner in progress, backed by a deep commitment to science and better healthcare. That commitment extends beyond the lab to how we operate, including our goal of reaching net zero by 2050.
 
NYSE: QGEN | Frankfurt Prime Standard: QIA
Learn more at www.qiagen.com

Name: Novonesis
Description:
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology are key to tackling the challenges our world faces. 

Enzymes, functional proteins and microorganisms are our planet's tiniest, yet mightiest agents of change. When we leverage their power with science, we create biosolutions that transform the way we all produce, consume and live.  

Today, we are 10,000 people worldwide whose expertise spans more than 30 different industries. All around the world our biosolutions already create value for thousands of customers and benefit the planet. Our solutions enable feeding and fueling the world more sustainably, from healthy and sustainable nutrition to biofuel. Biosolutions also reduce the use of fossil-based resources, chemicals, energy and water. And this is just the beginning. The potential is almost endless.   

The time for biosolutions is now. And by working closely with our partners and customers, we will continue to challenge conventional thinking and transform business with biology. Together, we will create the change our world needs. 

Let’s better our world with biology.

Name: Novozymes
Description:
Novozymes has combined with Chr. Hansen to become Novonesis: linkedin.com/company/novonesis. 

This global biosolutions company of 10,000 people is transforming how the world produces, consumes and lives. In 30-plus industries, its biosolutions help businesses meet their needs and the needs of our planet.  

Novozymes was formed in 2000 when Novo Nordisk split into three companies: Novo Nordisk A/S, Novozymes A/S and Novo A/S. Novozymes was the world leader in biological solutions with a commitment to Rethink Tomorrow. It served 130 markets with enzymatic, microbial and advanced protein solutions. The company’s solutions enabled higher agricultural yields, low-temperature washing, energy-efficient production, renewable fuel and many other benefits. 

In December 2022, Novozymes and Chr. Hansen entered into an agreement to create a leading global biosolutions partner by combining the two companies. The goal was to unleash the full potential of biosolutions and generate significant value for all stakeholders and society. The combination was completed on January 29, 2024 and Novonesis was born. The name means ‘a new beginning’ and is derived from the Greek word ‘genesis’. It reflects a new era where we’ll better our world with biology. You can find Novonesis on LinkedIn here: linkedin.com/company/novonesis. 

Novozymes A/S, part of Novonesis Group.

Name: Genmab
Description:
We are an international biotechnology company dedicated to improving the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases through innovative antibody medicines. Long recognized for our expertise in antibody innovation, our passionate and collaborative team has pioneered antibody-based formats, including bispecific antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, immune-modulating antibodies, and other modalities for the treatment of cancer and other serious diseases. 
Today, we are advancing a strong late-stage clinical pipeline, including wholly owned programs, with the goal of delivering transformative medicines to patients.
Our quest to turn science into medicine and transform the treatment of cancer and other serious diseases is guided by our core values: a passion for innovation, determination, integrity, working as one team, and respecting each other. When you work at Genmab you'll be part of a warm, fun, dynamic community seeking out and embracing the opportunity to build new and bold futures within a rapidly growing biotechnology company. Genmab is a place where you can be authentically you; you are empowered to innovate, build solutions and execute; you feel cared for and supported. Altogether, this makes working at Genmab an extra[not]ordinary experience. 
Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Genmab has a strong international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com. 
Disclaimer: http://gmab.ly/Jn0e50XWplA

Name: FUJIFILM Biotechnologies
Description:
For over 30 years, FUJIFILM Biotechnologies' mission has been advancing tomorrow’s medicine. As a CDMO, we work in partnership with the most innovative biopharma and biotech companies across the world who are reimagining healthcare’s potential. We help to accelerate their progress, expand their capabilities, streamline their processes, and strengthen their innovation. So when our customers’ potential cures, vaccines, biologics, and accomplishments make strides – or even become new realities for patients – we know our work, our manufacturing expertise, and our partnership helped make it happen. 

We aren't simply a workplace. FUJIFILM Biotechnologies a community and place of passion – a place of what we call Genki. A place where diverse perspectives and people come to life. Where opportunity for growth has no end. Where passion is followed, discovered, and nurtured. Where the energy is undeniable, enthusiasm is pervasive, and drive is infectious. All of our global locations burst with curiosity, inspiration, and extraordinary purpose. 

So as we continue to grow our teams, our global locations, and our capabilities, Genki will always be our cultural tie. That’s why we’re always looking for passionate, mission-driven people who want to commit their life’s work to enabling better outcomes for patients and their families. 

For a full listing of jobs that will propel, inspire, and fulfill you, please visit: https://fujifilmbiotechnologies.fujifilm.com/careers/

We created this space on LinkedIn to give people a window into our work and culture. We’re highlighting employees’ passion, current openings, and why it’s never been a more exciting time to join!

Name: Chr. Hansen
Description:
Chr. Hansen has combined with Novozymes to become Novonesis: linkedin.com/company/novonesis. This global biosolutions company of 10,000 people is transforming how the world produces, consumes and lives. In 30-plus industries, its biosolutions help businesses meet their needs and the needs of our planet. 

Chr. Hansen was founded in 1874 by the Danish pharmacist Christian D. A. Hansen who invented an industrial process to extract rennet for cheese making. The company was a microbial powerhouse that developed natural ingredient solutions for the food, nutritional, pharmaceutical and agricultural industries. Its unique microbial and fermentation technology platforms and collection of around 50,000 microbial strains helped it meet its commitment to grow a better world. Naturally. 

In December 2022, Chr. Hansen and Novozymes entered into an agreement to create a leading global biosolutions partner by combining the two companies. The goal was to unleash the full potential of biosolutions and generate significant value for all stakeholders and society. The combination was completed on January 29, 2024, and Novonesis was born. The name means ‘a new beginning’ and is derived from the Greek word ‘genesis’. It reflects a new era where we’ll better our world with biology. You can find Novonesis on LinkedIn here: linkedin.com/company/novonesis.

Chr. Hansen A/S, part of Novonesis Group.

Name: Ascendis Pharma
Description: Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on applying our innovative TransCon technology platform to make a meaningful difference for patients. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, and following our algorithm for product innovation, we apply TransCon to develop new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs. Ascendis is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, and has additional facilities in Europe and the United States. Please visit ascendispharma.com to learn more.

Name: Dianox
Description: We believe biotechnology is the most important aspect of health. Our team is dedicated to democratizing knowledge of building better life science tools to advance human health.

Name: Zealand Pharma
Description:
At Zealand Pharma, we are a Danish biotechnology company on a mission to change lives with next generation peptide medicines.

In our effort to reach our goals, bonding is at the core of everything we do. Let it be discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, engaging with partners or connecting with each other.

Ten drug candidates invented by Zealand Pharma have advanced into clinical development, of which two have reached the market. Our current pipeline of internal product candidates focuses on obesity, chronic inflammation, and certain rare diseases.

Our leading obesity programs are backed by strong partners, including Roche and Boehringer Ingelheim.

We are based in Copenhagen (Søborg), Denmark, with a team in the U.S. For further information about our business and activities, please visit www.zealandpharma.com or bond with us through LinkedIn.

Name: BioInnovation Institute (BII)
Description:
Do you have a great research-based idea in planetary health or human health? Are you ready to bring your research out of the lab and into the economy? 

BioInnovation Institute (BII) offers life science researcher and entrepreneurs access to a vibrant life science community with 3500 square meter of advanced lab and office facilities, business acceleration programs, commercial support, funding opportunities and access to high-level mentoring and networks. We embrace every stage of a life science start-up, so whether the idea of pursuing entrepreneurship has briefly crossed your mind, or you already have a full business plan for your project, there is a place for you at BII.

We are a Novo Nordisk Foundation Initiative, and we work for the benefit of human welfare and society.

Name: Gubra
Description:
Gubra is a biotech company built on three synergistic business units, Biotech, CRO Services, and Ventures, united by a commitment to scientific excellence, strong partnerships, and responsible impact. ESG principles are embedded in our business model, including Gubra Green, our subsidiary that allocates 10% of pre-tax profits to support a net-zero, nature-positive future.

Founded in 2008, Gubra has grown from a metabolic research specialist into a diversified organization of more than 300 scientists and experts. Today, we advance proprietary therapeutic programs, deliver high-end preclinical research services to global partners, and create new drug discovery opportunities through agile venture structures.

Our Biotech unit develops a growing pipeline of peptide-based therapeutics targeting metabolic diseases. Lead obesity programs include partnered assets ABBV-295 (a long-acting amylin analogue) and BI 3034701 (a triple agonist). Our internal lead candidate, GUB-UCN2, is a next-generation peptide for healthy weight loss now progressing in clinical development.

Our specialized preclinical CRO provides world-class capabilities across in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, peptide chemistry, molecular pharmacology, histology, stereology, AI-enhanced imaging, and bioinformatics. Gubra is recognized for deep expertise in metabolic diseases and for highly translatable preclinical models.

Through Gubra Ventures, we develop high-potential science with clear translational hypotheses. Focusing on novel modalities in our core therapeutic areas, we target high-value disease segments where our peptide expertise creates competitive advantage. These focused, flexible structures enable promising programs to progress rapidly while staying closely connected to our scientific foundation.

Guided by science, speed, and a commitment to doing business in the best way for people and the planet, we bring together biotech innovation, world-class research, and entrepreneurial venturing.

Name: Nordic Bioscience
Description:
Nordic Bioscience is the leading expert in extracellular matrix (ECM) research. We support some of the largest pharmaceutical companies in preclinical and clinical research with three decades of experience in biomarker development. With more than 750 peer-reviewed publications, our science-driven approach has been the evolving force behind our decades of success.

Through our Nordic ProteinFingerPrint TechnologyTM, we identify fragments of the extracellular matrix (ECM) that are released from affected tissues and develop blood-based biomarker assays to quantify disease activity with the aim of precision medicine.

By quantifying tissue remodeling, our biomarkers provide true prognostic and predictive value, as we can select the patients who are most likely to respond to a given treatment and thereby function as surrogate biomarkers for clinical trials. Our biomarker assays not only enable faster drug development but also improve disease outcomes for chronically ill patients by predicting treatment response.

Nordic Bioscience is headquartered in Herlev, Denmark, with a high-quality standard laboratory, running clinical trials under Good Clinical Laboratory Practice (GCLP) with accreditation by the College of American Pathologists (CAP), certification by Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA), and an ISO9001 certificate. Everything in our laboratory supports compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11. We employ more than 220 people who are dedicated to improving patient management for a broad range of therapeutic areas, including Cardiology, Dermatology, Gastroenterology, Hepatology, Kidney and Respiratory diseases, Obesity, Oncology, and Rheumatology.

Read more about us:
https://www.nordicbioscience.com/about/about-us

Name: Nelson Labs
Description:
Nelson Labs is a global leader in microbiological and analytical chemistry testing and advisory services for the medical device and pharmaceutical industries. Nelson Labs serves over 3,500 customers across 15 facilities in the United States, Mexico, Asia, and Europe. We have a comprehensive array of over 800 laboratory tests supporting our customers from initial product development and sterilization validation, through regulatory approval and ongoing product testing for sterility, safety and quality assurance. We are regarded as a best-in-class partner with a strong track record of collaborating with customers to solve complex issues. Learn more about Nelson Labs at www.nelsonlabs.com. 

Safeguarding Global Health - with every test we complete.

Name: BioArctic
Description:
With patients in mind, we are committed to our vision: A world where scince defeats severe brain diseases.  

BioArctic AB (publ) is an innovative Swedish biopharma company focusing on research and develop into neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and ALS. With world-leading science and strong collaborations, we create, develop, and provide innovative treatments for patients with severe brain diseases. 
BioArctic has also developed the BrainTransporterTM technology, which has the potential to actively transport antibodies and other biological molecules across the blood-brain barrier to enhance distribution in the brain and drug efficacy.
 
Collaborations are of great importance to the company and partnering with global pharma companies is a key element of our strategy. Our project portfolio is broad and well-diversified, with the potential to significantly improve the health of patients.

The company was founded in 2003 based on innovative research at Uppsala University.

Name: Zevra Therapeutics
Description:
We are a purpose-driven, commercial-stage company with a late-stage pipeline committed to redefining what is possible in bringing life-changing therapies to people living with rare diseases. We involve key thought leaders, physicians, patients, care partners, and advocacy groups in all of our clinical and regulatory development strategies.

With a keen understanding that drug development often requires creative solutions, we have the insight and expertise to forge new pathways to success that others have missed. By following the data without bias, our transparent narratives and common-sense perspective have successfully overcome complex development challenges to make much-needed therapies available to patients.

Nimble and dauntless, we push boundaries beyond what is thought to be possible and advance new therapies that have the potential to bring meaningful improvement to patients’ lives.

Name: Aquaporin A/S
Description: Aquaporin is an innovative water technology company with operations in Denmark (HQ), Singapore, Turkey, the United States, and China. We are committed to rethinking water filtration with biotechnology to solve global water challenges. By combining three disciplines from the world of natural sciences: biology, chemistry, and physics, we have created the unique, nature-inspired Aquaporin Inside technology, which we embed into all our products. Our technology is based on Nobel Prize-winning research and is used to clean and reuse water in industries, in our homes, and even by NASA in space. We work with customers and partners around the globe to responsibly treat industrial wastewater, concentrate food and beverage products in a natural way, and enhance drinking water quality and accessibility.

Name: DTU Bioengineering
Description:
Department of Biotechnology and Biomedicine or in short "DTU Bioengineering" is a scientific community where all members contribute to teaching and research activities that all aim to meet national and international demands for development of sustainable, environmentally friendly, and competitive processes for use within the areas of biotechnology and biomedicine.

The particular strength of DTU Bioengineering is that teaching and research activities originate from the integrated use of expertise in disciplines such as molecular biotechnology, biochemistry, microbiology, chemistry, physics, and chemical techniques.

The research at DTU Bioengineering covers both basic and applied areas of relevance for biotechnology and biomedicine. Research activities are carried out by all faculty staff at the department. The research is described in three interwoven areas where most, if not all, scientists have activities that fall under two or even all three of the research areas; Microbiology, Biomedicine and Biotechnology.

Name: Biotech Research & Innovation Centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen
Description:
Biotech Research & Innovation Centre (BRIC) was established in 2003 by the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation. Today BRIC is a centre of excellence for biomedical research. The scientists in the centre focus on understanding the molecular mechanisms leading to various diseases, including cancer, CNS-related diseases and metabolic diseases. Our aims are to:

- perform interdisciplinary, cutting-edge research
- establish a strong research education programme
- attract funding and new research projects
- ensure that research results are used for the development of commercial products
- promote exchange of ideas within the Danish biotech research community

Name: Liofilchem
Description:
Since 1983, Liofilchem produces:

- devices for antimicrobial susceptibility testing such as MTSTM (MIC Test Strip), antibiotic discs, broth micro dilution panels, agar dilution panels, chromogenic culture media for resistance mechanisms detections.

- galleries and biochemical tests for microbial identification.

- ready to use culture media in petri dishes, tubes, bottles, bags and dip-slides.

- dehydrated culture media and growth supplements.

- swabs, contact plates and contact slides for the microbiological monitoring of surfaces.

- bio-indicators for the sterilization process validations and control.

- freeze-dried organisms for QC and growth promotion testing.

- sanitizers for skin and surfaces.

Liofilchem is certified by TÜV to ISO 9001 for the quality management and to ISO 13485 for the development and production of IVD devices. The Liofilchem products for clinical microbiology are CE marked and comply with the European IVD-D and IVD-R, the US FDA, Health Canada and are registered at the health authorities in many countries around the world.

 The Liofilchem products are used in over 150 Countries.

 Headquarters, Manufacturing Site, International distribution center are based in Roseto degli Abruzzi, Italy. 

 Liofilchem, Inc. based in Waltham, MA, in the greater Boston area, is the US sales and distribution center. 

 Liofilchem Nordics ApS is the sales and representation center for Scandinavia, based in Copenhagen.

Name: Servier Symphogen
Description: Servier Symphogen A/S, a Servier company and the Centre of Excellence for Antibodies, operates within in research, early clinical stages and CMC biologics development from research to market. Supporting Servier’s commitment to improve patients health and the R&D strategy within oncology and immune-oncology - Symphogen’s  strategic focus is to apply our streamlined and effective antibody platform and capabilities in the discovery and early development of highly differentiated antibodies. The aim is to develop novel compounds either as combination or as stand-alone therapies for difficult to treat cancers.

Name: Sophion Bioscience
Description:
Sophion was founded in the year 2000 by a group of passionate electrophysiologists, all having the shared purpose of making patch clamping objective and independent of user skills to provide faster, more accurate and objective patch clamping results. “To take the voodoo out of patch clamping”.

Over the past twenty years, we have developed from a startup into a global organization, but the passion and drive to provide high-performance patch clamp solutions persist.

With our complete technical, biological and application support we help our partners to achieve their targets, and through the continued development of our QPatch and Qube platforms, we ensure that we offer uncompromised data quality in a user-friendly environment from assay setup to data analysis.

Name: Evosep Biosystems
Description:
Evosep develops new solutions to make clinical proteomics 100 times more robust and 10 times faster.

We are targeting the growing need for throughput with robust solutions for clinical and large-scale proteomics, and we have a very ambitious business plan to bring the community closer to the clinic.
 
We are basing our design on years of experience with nano-UHPLC R&D and application support, critically rethinking the necessary system architectures for successful sample separation before mass spectrometric analysis.

Name: Evaxion A/S
Description: Evaxion A/S is a pioneering TechBio company based upon its AI platform, AI-ImmunologyTM. Evaxion’s proprietary and scalable AI prediction models harness the power of artificial intelligence to decode the human immune system and develop novel immunotherapies for cancer, bacterial diseases, and viral infections. Based upon AI-ImmunologyTM, Evaxion has developed a clinical-stage oncology pipeline of novel personalized vaccines and a preclinical infectious disease pipeline in bacterial and viral diseases with high unmet medical needs. Evaxion is committed to transforming patients’ lives by providing innovative and targeted treatment options. For more information about Evaxion and its groundbreaking AI-ImmunologyTM platform and vaccine pipeline, please visit our website.

Name: Roche Danmark
Description:
Velkommen til Roche Danmarks LinkedIn profil.

En sundere fremtid. Det er vores motivation. 

Derfor har vi engageret os i danskernes sundhed gennem samarbejde med aktørerne i det danske sundhedsvæsen i mere end 50 år.
 
Med fokus på samlede forløb tilbyder vi digitale sundhedsløsninger med datadrevne teknologier og indsigter, der knytter tidlige diagnoser til målrettede behandlinger af alle sygdomme.
 
Vores tilstedeværelse herhjemme er udbredt gennem flere led i værdikæden. Vi indgår ligeledes i partnerskaber på tværs af sundhedssektoren, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger og behandlinger for patienterne opnås gennem samskabelse mellem aktørerne.
 
Fra vores kontor i Carlsberg Byen og decentralt placerede kolleger samarbejder vi med partnere, hospitaler, laboratorier, klinikere og patienter over hele landet for at skabe de bedste løsninger og behandlingsforløb for patienterne.
 
Roche Danmarks tre juridiske enheder - Roche Pharmaceuticals A/S, Roche Diagnostics A/S og Roche Diabetes Care - er de danske datterselskaber af F. Hoffmann-La Roche koncernen, der er globalt førende inden for diagnostik og lægemidler. Med et budget på 109 milliarder kroner er vi ligeledes den sundhedsvirksomhed i verden, der investerer mest i forskning og udvikling. Og dermed vejen til en sundere fremtid for alle.

M-DK-00000881

Name: SNIPR - A CRISPR Company
Description: By harnessing CRISPR-powered technology to target antibiotic-resistant bacteria, we are spearheading the development of the next generation of lifesaving treatments.

Name: Reshape Biotech
Description:
Reshape Biotech is building the next generation of lab automation robots. Our customers are biotech companies tackling the world’s biggest problems - be it alternative protein development or sustainable agriculture. Reshape Biotech is the scaling factor for these companies, as we let researchers collaborate globally on experiments and increase their throughput >500x.

The team is highly multi-disciplinary, employing everything from PhD’s in biology to hardware and software engineers. We work closely together, and you will be exposed to a truly vertical team.

We’re a fast growing startup with an incredibly ambitious team, dead-set on reinventing a 100 year old industry and becoming the standard infrastructure that the world of biotech relies on. Our customers already include global leaders in food, agriculture and biologicals. 

We’re backed by top tier investors from Y Combinator, CEOs from the industry and some of the biggest names you can find. At Reshape Biotech, you have the potential to influence how biotech research is done in the next 100 years.

Name: 21st.BIO
Description:
21st.BIO was founded with one simple mission: to make leading industrial scale precision fermentation technology accessible to as many as possible, so companies can successfully take biotech innovations to market at a competitive price. 21st.BIO focuses on developing industrial production technology for proteins and other molecules of interest for food, nutrition, agriculture, biomaterials, and biomining industries.

21st.BIO's founders saw that too often, great bio innovation and molecules fail to translate into commercial success. The innovation is ready, the market is there, but production costs remain too high for the product to go mainstream. Industry insiders call it the 'valley of death', and that's exactly what 21st.BIO intends to bridge. 

Founded in 2020, 21st.BIO is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, and has a world-class R&D team as well as laboratories in both Copenhagen, Denmark and Davis, California. On a mission to support bio industrial companies globally in upscaling from molecule innovation to large-scale production, 21st.BIO enables its customers to meet market demands, and thereby advance the green transition globally. 

Established as a fully integrated end-to-end partner, 21st.BIO supports its customers from technical assessment, strain development and optimization, production processes and upscaling, tech transfer to large scale manufacturing and regulatory services.  21st.BIO's fermentation technology is in part licensed from Novonesis, who have developed and perfected their platform over several decades.

Name: Hemab Therapeutics
Description: Hemab is a clinical-stage biotech company developing the first prophylactic therapeutics for serious, underserved bleeding and thrombotic disorders. Based in Cambridge, Massachusetts and Copenhagen, Denmark, Hemab is progressing a pipeline of monoclonal and bispecific antibody-based therapeutics to transform the treatment paradigm for patients with high unmet need. The company’s strategic guidance, Hemab 1-2-5, targets the development of 5 clinical assets by 2025 to deliver long-awaited innovation for patients with high unmet need blood clotting disorders like Glanzmann Thrombasthenia, factor VII deficiency, Bernard Soulier Syndrome, Von Willebrand Disease and other serious disorders. Learn more at hemab.com.

Name: Octarine Bio
Description:
Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based company pioneering a new generation of sustainable, bio-based colourants produced via precision fermentation. We engineer nature inspired colours that deliver the performance, stability, and safety profile required for demanding industrial applications while decoupling colour from fossil based chemistry.

Our PurePaletteTM portfolio offers bio-based colourants for use on textiles, plastics, packaging, and other materials. Designed for drop-in integration, PurePaletteTM targets price parity with conventional colourants in key use cases, enabling customers to adopt more sustainable solutions without compromising on cost, quality, or scalability.

Name: Again
Description:
At Again we put CO2 to good use. 

By combining millennia-old bacteria with cutting-edge technology, we turn CO2 into carbon negative chemicals. Our novel biomanufacturing process collects the unavoidable carbon outputs from industry and reuses them to manufacture emission-free chemicals - a win-win for everyone. 

We’re leading the positive shift. Showing people that our world does have a future. 

If you think we’re doomed – think Again.

Name: Adcendo
Description:
Adcendo is a global clinical-stage biotech company dedicated to developing transformative first- and potential best-in-class antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) therapies targeting cancers with high unmet medical need. Led by a team of experienced biopharma executives with a track record of advancing multiple ADCs to approval, Adcendo integrates novel targets, optimized linker-payload combinations, and a rationally designed development strategy to drive next-generation cancer therapies. 

Designed for Precision. 

Developed for Life.

Read more at www.adcendo.com

Name: Biosyntia
Description:
Biosyntia is a biotech startup within synthetic biology and metabolic engineering. We develop biocatalysts at an unprecedented speed and efficiency by employing our patent pending high-throughput screening technology.

By developing tailored processes based on biocatalysis, Biosyntia enables production of complex chemical compounds by fermentation. Biocatalysis may substantially reduce both production costs and environmental impact compared to other processes such as chemical synthesis. We partner with manufacturers of fine chemical compounds (flavors, fragrances, APIs, pigments, additives, intermediates, and more) in order to establish more sustainable manufacturing processes for a greener tomorrow.

Biosyntia is located at a startup incubator (Symbion) in Copenhagen, just a few kilometers from the center of the city.

Name: Y-mAbs Therapeutics, Inc.
Description:
Y-mAbs is a commercial-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of novel, antibody-based therapeutic products for the treatment of cancer. We have a broad and advanced product pipeline, including pivotal-stage product candidates against a range of targets.

Our mission is to become the world leader in developing better and safer antibody-based oncology products addressing clear unmet pediatric and adult medical needs. With the right partnerships and collaborations, we envision changing the course of cancer care and its outcomes.

Name: Minerva Imaging
Description: Minerva Imaging is a scientifically driven CRO and CDMO specialized in targeted radionuclide therapies. The company focusses on the use of advanced models within oncology, cardiovascular diseases and in vivo molecular imaging for translational research and drug development. Minerva Imaging engages with its clients to understand their scientific questions and discuss how its methods and capabilities can provide answers. The facility located in Denmark offers best–in–industry fully integrated radiopharmaceutical research, drug development and manufacturing services.

Name: Bactolife
Description:
We're on a mission to improve global gut health and help combat antimicrobial resistance.

Bactolife is a Danish biosolutions company pioneering a new category of food ingredients: HelmTM Binding Proteins that selectively bind and block harmful microbial activity without disturbing the beneficial microbiome. Our binding proteins can be incorporated into foods, beverages, and dietary supplements. 

Backed by leading investors including Cross Border Impact Ventures, EIFO, Novo Holdings, and Athos, we're working to make HelmTM Binding Proteins a globally accessible solution for better gut health.

Join us as we shape the future of gut health.

Name: HAMLET PROTEIN
Description:
The world population continues to grow. Feeding future generations through safe and affordable meat, eggs and dairy requires a sustainable approach to agriculture that benefits people, the planet and producers’ profit.  

Hamlet Protein is proud to be a trusted partner of feed mills, premixers, home mixers, integrators and farmers across the world. Combining global insights with a local network, we happily share our knowledge and provide constant technical support. That is how we promote increased productivity, profitability and sustainability for our customers.

We believe that young animal nutrition is the key to increase productivity throughout the life cycle. Our soy based specialty ingredients help promote health through nutrition right from the start.

Our team is passionate about making a difference. We have the experience, science and track record to back it up.

Name: IO Biotech
Description:
IO Biotech is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel, immune-modulatory, off-the-shelf therapeutic cancer vaccines based on its T-win platform. The T-win platform is based on a novel approach to cancer vaccines designed to activate T cells to target both tumor cells and the immune-suppressive cells in the tumor microenvironment. IO Biotech is advancing its lead cancer vaccine candidate, Cylembio, in clinical trials, and additional pipeline candidates through preclinical development. IO Biotech is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and has US headquarters in New York, New York.

IO Biotech has an experienced management team within the immune-oncology field and a world-class advisory board.

Name: Eurofins Danmark - Laboratorium
Description:
Vil du være med til at teste alt fra jord til bord? Så er Eurofins stedet for dig. Eurofins er nemlig førende inden for Testing For Life - hvilket betyder, at vi laver næsten alle former for analyser og ydelser til områderne miljø, DNA-analyser, fødevarer, foder, materialer og produkter samt pharma. 

Vores laboratorier i Danmark er beliggende i Vejen, Glostrup, Ishøj, Aabybro, Aarhus og Galten. I Danmark er vi mere end 1.100 kollegaer, og vi er altid på udkig efter talentfulde og højt motiverede medarbejdere. På denne side kan du blive klogere på. hvordan Eurofins er som arbejdsplads.

Name: Automated Engineering Services, Inc.
Description:
AES (Automated Engineering Services) is a full end-to-end partner for biotech and biopharma manufacturing.

We don’t just integrate systems—we design, build, automate, manufacture, validate, and even staff entire operations from lab scale to full commercial production.

Unlike traditional integrators, AES is 100% focused on life sciences. We live this industry every day, which means we understand the science, the process, the regulations, and the urgency required to bring therapies to market.

A true end-to-end model. We support the entire facility and process lifecycle:

• Process & facility design
• Custom or configurable equipment manufacturing (OEM)
• Automation, integration & data connectivity
• Commissioning, qualification & validation (CQV)
• Staffing, consulting, and operational support

Equipment built for your process—not the other way around

We manufacture modular, configurable, and fully custom equipment across upstream, downstream, and cross-process operations. Whether it’s bioreactors, perfusion, liquid handling, filtration, TFF, chromatography, automation platforms—or something that has never existed before—we engineer solutions to fit your bioprocess, not generic standards.

We support the full spectrum of biotech and biomanufacturing, including:

• Cell Therapy
• Gene Therapy
• Antibodies & Recombinant Proteins
• Vaccine Production
• CMO / CDMO Operations
• Cultured Foods / Alternative Proteins
• Industrial Biotechnology

Global reach. Fast deployment. Real execution.

Our worldwide footprint and mobility infrastructure allow us to mobilize teams quickly—with permits, visas, and site access fast-tracked—so projects don’t stall.

Why AES?
Because we build more than equipment.
We build the ecosystem that makes manufacturing work—efficiently, compliantly, and at scale.

AES is where engineering, equipment, and innovation converge to bring bioprocesses to life

Name: Muna Therapeutics
Description:
Muna Therapeutics is a privately held biopharmaceutical company founded in 2020 and based in Copenhagen, Denmark. 

Muna discovers and develops therapies that slow or stop devastating neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer’s, Frontotemporal Dementia and Parkinson’s. These disorders impact memory, movement, language, behavior and personality resulting in disability and death of millions of patients around the globe. 

We focus our groundbreaking science on identifying new medicines to preserve cognition and other brain functions and enhance resilience to neurodegenerative diseases.  Our name reflects this focus:  Muna means ‘to remember’ in Old Norse.

Name: VikingGenetics
Description:
At VikingGenetics, we breed healthy, efficient, trouble-free cows. We provide science-based bovine genetic products and solutions for progressive dairy and beef producers around the world. Our passion is to help you as a farmer achieve your business goals, farm sustainably, and enjoy life.

As a co-operative, VikingGenetics has 16,000 members - dairy and beef farmers from Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. We focus on animal welfare, food security, and reducing climate impact in our entire production chain. We partner with universities, research organisations, and experts across the globe to give you tools and technology to select the best bulls.

With our solutions, you can continuously improve the genetic gain for each generation of your herd. Our results are rooted in the long-term relationships with our farmers and the close link between research and implementation. Our commitment is to lead the dairy and beef industry in finding solutions to lower methane emissions and breed long-lasting climate-friendly cows.

Name: Chromologics
Description: Chromologics is a Danish biotech start-up responding to the strong market pull for novel natural food colorants. We develop fungal fermentation solutions for the production of natural pigments. Our proprietary production process allows not only for a more sustainable production than existing solutions, but is also cost-competitive. Our pigments are produced by a non-GMO fungus, which makes them compliant with the dietary requirements of broad consumer bases such as kosher, halal, and vegan diets.

Name: CliniSciences Group
Description:
CliniSciences commercialises reagents (antibodies, recombinants, ELISA kits, RNAi, cDNA clones, probes, PCR/qPCR reagents...) to diagnostic and research labs. Name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Cellerator
Description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Cellerator is built on the belief that cell therapy holds the key to curing chronic or life-threatening diseases. That is why we are creating the Cellerator, a state-of-the-art hub dedicated to advancing the cell therapy ecosystem by accelerating the development and manufacturing of cell therapies for early clinical trials. Our facility at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) will support multiple cell types and provide essential services such as process development, GMP manufacturing and release, and regulatory support.
 
Built to close the gap from technology to treatment, Cellerator shortens the journey from groundbreaking concepts to clinical trials. We achieve this by fostering partnerships among startups, pharmaceutical companies, and research institutions, leveraging our expertise, network, and infrastructure to develop and commercialize new cell therapies more effectively.

Cellerator, expected to be operational by 2027, is a philanthropic initiative that serves public and private clients globally, to further advance the field. 

We believe in the future of regenerative medicine and are dedicated to accelerating transformative treatments for a healthier tomorrow. 

Follow us and visit our website to learn more and sign up for the interest list.
