Name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Initiative for Vaccines and Immunity (NIVI)
Description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Initiative for Vaccines and Immunity (NIVI) brings together leading experts in airway immunology and vaccine development to tackle some of the deadliest respiratory pathogens. The aim is to revolutionize and accelerate vaccine development by bridging the gap between academic research and industry innovation.

NIVI is a partnership between the University of Copenhagen and the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The initiative is comprised of two distinct entities:

NIVI Research Center is a state-of-the-art academic research center anchored at the Department of Immunology and Microbiology at the University of Copenhagen. NIVI-R directs the research, discovery and educational aspects of the NIVI initiative. 
For more information: https://niviresearch.ku.dk/about-center/

NIVI Development is a limited liability company owned by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. NIVI-D facilitates the initiatives translational efforts by providing industry-level expertise in vaccine development and clinical testing.

NIVI’s VISION & MISSION

Vision: To prevent airborne epidemics and limit the spread of anti-microbial resistance through the development of novel vaccines.

Mission: To generate knowledge on host immunity, host-pathogen interactions, and vaccine technologies. And to translate this knowledge into vaccines that provide robust, durable and broad immunity against respiratory pathogens.

Name: PrecisionLife
Description:
We're addressing one of the greatest challenges of our time - transforming healthcare to predict, treat, and prevent the world's most costly diseases.

Chronic diseases are the biggest challenge facing global health. Billions of people live with debilitating conditions that are misunderstood, misdiagnosed, and mistreated - crippling healthcare systems, limiting quality of life, and costing trillions of dollars around the world.

PrecisionLife is here to change that.

We've developed the world's leading AI and genetic analysis platform on the planet to decipher the biological drivers of complex conditions and solve chronic disease.

Our analytics platform reveals the unique biological mechanisms that cause disease and the biology that can protect people. This lets us:

• Develop low-cost, non-invasive tests that can predict diseases earlier and with greater accuracy
• Help doctors match patients to the most effective treatments and specialisms based on their personal biology
• Support pharmaceutical companies to develop more targeted therapies and clinical trials with greater probability of success
• Develop personalized healthcare solutions to prevent chronic diseases

Our approach is groundbreaking and already helping to tackle 60+ diseases across neuroscience, women's health, cardiovascular disease and immunology.

We’ve created the world’s largest repository of chronic disease insights and IP, and are working with partners across healthcare and industry to bring truly personalized medicine to patients - improving lives and reducing the unsustainable pressure on health systems.

Our mission is bold but simple:
To give every patient a faster, clearer path to better health – creating more personalized treatment options and diagnostic tools to reduce the global burden of chronic disease through precision medicine that works for everyone.

Name: ALGIECEL
Description:
WHO WE ARE & WHAT WE DO 
ALGIECEL is a BioSolutions company on a mission to deliver sustainable, high-quality ingredients at scale – meeting the growing global demand without pressuring our planet’s ecosystem.  
Harnessing nature’s own way and putting it to use at industrial scale, we grow microalgae using light and CO2 in modular photobioreactors.  
Our microalgae-based ingredients are rich in protein, omega-3 and bioactives.  
We are building a reliable, scalable source of marine nutrients for food, feed and cosmetic markets – without exploiting nature. 

WHY WE DO IT 
With the way we feed to world today, we are overexploiting planetary boundaries.  
There is a critical need for reliable partners who can translate innovation into industrial capacity for sustainable ingredients at scale.  
ALGIECEL exists to provide an alternative with low CO2, water and land use, to customers that want to decarbonize their value chain.  

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT 
1.Ingredient Value: We offer premium-quality, microalgae-based ingredients with consistent functionality and full traceability—designed to meet the rigorous standards of modern supply chains. 
2. Sustainability: Our production process minimizes CO2 emissions, water use, and land footprint—replacing resource-intensive ingredients like fish oil and fish meal.
3. Modular System: Our compact, modular photobioreactor system enables low-risk, flexible scaling with strong unit economics—making sustainable growth achievable, one module at a time.

Name: Samplix
Description:
Samplix offers a cutting-edge droplet-based instrument for single-cell analysis in immunotherapy research. Our double emulsion technology enables seamless analysis and sorting on flow cytometers. Empower your research today!

Xdrop encapsulates living cells and reactive molecules in highly stable double-emulsion droplets that act as microenvironments for rapid cell–cell and cell–molecule interactions during incubation. The droplets are suitable for flow cytometry and sorting.

The limited volume forces fast interactions and causes secreted substances to quickly build up to detectable levels, meaning shorter screening times. The separation of the cell population into droplets containing single cells with no crosstalk means you get highly accurate, single-cell resolution results of the heterogeneous activity or potency of the cells rather than an averaged readout that hides critical information.

Xdrop is ideal for engineered cell therapy research, protein engineering and other synthetic biology workflows, and other cell interaction- or cell secretion-based workflow.

Name: Mann Lab
Description:
The department of Proteomics and Signal Transduction is headed by Prof. Matthias Mann and was established in 2005. Matthias Mann is the highest cited German researcher by his h-index of more than 276 and over 350,000 citations ( google scholar). In addition to his group at the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry, Matthias Mann is the director of the proteomics program at the Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Research (NNF-CPR) in Copenhagen where he also leads the Clinical Proteomics group ( clinical proteomics group).

The Mann lab is a leader in the technology and application of mass spectrometry-based proteomics and has been at the forefront of the field for almost three decades. The core research interests of the group are signal transduction, biomarker discovery and metabolic diseases. Another focus is the development of mass spectrometric and proteomic methods for application in biological and clinical contexts. The group is also developing computer algorithms for automated identification and quantification of peptides as well as systems biological and clinical knowledge mining. 

Ultimately, our vision is to transfer proteomics knowledge into clinics for predictive, diagnostic and preventive purposes. We are a highly collaborative team and involved in several networks including Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research, European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (ISLET, MICROB-PREDICT), CLINSPECT-M and Munich Heart Alliance.

Name: Vesper Bio
Description:
Vesper Bio is a Danish clinical stage biotech company headquartered in Copenhagen, developing new disease-modifying treatments for people with neuropsychiatric and neurodegenerative diseases. We do this by a novel approach, targeting sortilin. We are developing first-in-class small molecule sortilin inhibitors for a number of critical unmet medical needs, such as mood disorders and frontotemporal dementia. 

Vesper Bio's investigational new drug candidate VES001, is a first-in-class, oral, brain-penetrant small molecule sortilin inhibitor in clinical development. It is being investigated as a potential disease-modifying therapy for both neuropsychiatric disease and frontotemporal dementia caused by mutations in the progranulin gene (FTD-GRN).

Name: Cambiotics
Description:
At Cambiotics, we are on a mission to create a healthier, PFAS-free future. These harmful "Forever Chemicals," found in everyday items like cookware, cosmetics, food packaging, and even water pose significant risks to human health and the environment. 

Through groundbreaking research and partnerships with institutions like Cambridge University and Quest Diagnostics, we have developed an innovative probiotic solution.  

Our flagship product, 46&, is a precision-formulated probiotic designed to naturally support the body’s fight against the Forever Chemicals. 

Join us as we innovate for a cleaner, healthier and Forever Chemicals free world.

Name: Teitur Trophics
Description:
Teitur develops novel therapeutics for treating or preventing neurodegenerative diseases.

Teitur is Old Norse for happiness. Our ambition and commitment is to create new treatments for patients suffering from neurodegenerative diseases to help them live a longer, better and happier life.

Name: Isolate Extraction Systems, Inc.
Description: Founded in 2012, Isolate Extraction systems Inc. (IES) manufactures safe, high quality, food grade super-critical CO2 extraction machines backed by expert service and a customer-first focus. We continue to develop state of the art technology and procedures to manufacture the most advanced equipment in regards to safety, efficiency, reliability and ease of use. Our Extractors are 100% automated using proprietary in-house designed software. IES is committed to the success of all of our customers and strongly believe in long-lasting relationships with all of our clients.

Name: HERVolution Therapeutics
Description: Advancing immunotherapies targeting “dark genome” antigens, specifically HERV-K. Aberrant activation and expression of HERV-K in chronic inflammation, metabolic stress, cancer, and aging — drive immune evasion, senescence, and metabolic dysfunction and disease. By breaking immune tolerance to HERV-K, HERVolution is developing differentiated, off-the-shelf therapies that sit at the intersection of inflammation, type-2 diabetes disease, oncology, and longevity.

Name: Green2x
Description:
At Green2x, we will produce advanced biofuels from straw at a highly competitive cost, offering a scalable way to secure Europe’s energy supply while accelerating the green transition. 

Our mission is simple and bold: turn straw into one of the world’s most competitive sources of biomethane.

With a single, energy dense feedstock, our proprietary technology and an optimized industrial design, we will produce unsubsidized, certified biomethane at market leading cost while achieving ~90% GHG displacement.

Our first commercial facility in Vordingborg will at full capacity be the world’s largest biomethane plant, producing more than 170 million m3 annually - and a blueprint for how renewable gas can be produced at scale. Construction of our pilot plant on Møn is now underway, forming the design basis for Vordingborg.

But this is only the beginning.

We are building Green2x to become a global leader in industrial scale biomethane - a company capable of developing, owning and operating a new generation of high output, high efficiency plants across multiple markets. With Equinor and EIFO as minority owners and strategic partners, we are positioned to accelerate from first-of-a-kind projects to international deployment.

Our focus:
• Industrial scale biomethane from straw - competitive without subsidies
• Patented technology built for high performance and replicability
• World class plant design enabling rapid global rollout
• Sustainable biomethane and biofuels that strengthen Europe’s energy security and climate resilience.

The world’s shift to renewable energy requires companies that can build real infrastructure, at real scale, with real impact.
That is what we are here to do.


Headquarters: Hellerup, Copenhagen area
Pilot Plan site: Ny Borre, Møn
Website: www.green2x.com

Name: Insai
Description: Insai is combining AI and neurotechnology to improve brain health. We build foundation models that extract clinically validated biomarkers from sleep and brain data - helping researchers and pharma teams better understand, measure, and treat neurological conditions.

Name: Biotekbyen - the Biotech City
Description:
The Biotech City of Kalundborg is a unique partnership between companies, educational institutions, the municipality, and other public organizations.

The Biotech City is a growth driver in Denmark – an industrial hotspot with Scandinavia's biggest biotech production and a strong process industry supported by an extensive follow-up industry of subcontractors, a growing ecosystem of SMEs and startups, and not least a growing number of business-relevant educational programs. 

The Biotech City e.g. includes the world’s largest insulin factory, the world's largest enzyme production, and the world's leading industrial symbiosis, to name a few.

WE COLLABORATE TO CREATE SMART AND CIRCULAR GROWTH ...
Kalundborg has more than 50 years of experience in committed partnerships and sustainable growth. The Biotech City holds a unique in Denmark's industrial production, which inspires partners far beyond Danish borders.

... BY PRIORITIZING EDUCATION, WORKFORCE ATTRACTION, AND CITY DEVELOPMENT ...
Together, we support and strengthen Kalundborg as an attractive place to study, work, and live.

- We increase awareness of Kalundborg's educational opportunities and strengthen the city's position as an educational city, focusing especially on the biotech and process industries as well as urban planning.

- We attract talented students and ensure a strong connection to the local business community. 

- We work to increase the number of educational opportunities in Kalundborg

- We support and ensure a qualified workforce for the area's business and research environments.

... TOGETHER.
- We collaborate across education, business, research, and the municipality - creating synergies, new ideas, and opportunities.

- We collaborate with partners: regionally, nationally, and internationally.

- We enhance each other's strengths, building on a strong tradition of committed partnerships and sustainable growth.

Name: LPS Biosolutions
Description:
PRECISION DOWNSTREAM PROCESSING FOR ISOLATION OF ALTERNATIVE PROTEINS AND VALUE-ADDED PROTEINS

We enable precision isolation of native and functional proteins:

- Providing downstream processing solutions for the Precision Fermentation and Molecular Farming Industry
- Providing selectivity and process economy for Plant Protein Isolates
- Providing transformation of the Milk and Whey Proteins market from a commodity to a value-added proteins business

Using our large toolbox of proprietary technologies and know-how we provide protein isolation solutions to the global protein markets within food, feed, and nutraceuticals.

CHIMERADS - OUR UNIQUE VALUE PROPOSITION

Our game changing ChimerAds technology selectively isolates the protein of choice from liquid raw materials using a unique adsorption format thereby eliminating the well-known operational draw backs and high cost of classical packed bed adsorption.

- ChimerAds efficiently treats large-scale liquid raw materials that are otherwise difficult to process using conventional methods
 - The specialized high-capacity adsorbents used in ChimerAds are produced from renewable materials and selectively bind to the desired proteins, ensuring high product yields and purity in a cost-effective process
- ChimerAds performs gentle and environmentally friendly separation processes which preserves protein functionality, making it ideal for industries where protein functionality is critical

Thus, ChimerAds provides a precise, efficient, and eco-friendly solution for industrial-scale protein recovery and isolation.

Name: Kem-En-Tec Nordic A/S
Description:
Kem-En-Tec Nordic is a niche lab supplier devoted to helping BioScience lab technicians enhance the quality of their work, whether it is in Pharma & Biotech, on Universities, or Hospitals.

We proudly represent a platform of products from more than 100 companies in the field of Protein Technology, Molecular Biology, Cellular Biology, Diagnostics, and Environmental studies. 

Combined with our 30+ years of market knowledge, we will help you find almost any reagent or kit you need. At Kem-En-Tec we help you to do better, faster, more cost-efficient, and sustainable in your research and diagnostics with innovation and uniqueness. 

We aim to be your top service partner, and our highly trained scientific staff takes great pride in knowing that you will quickly receive a qualified reply to any inquiry. Please do not hesitate to contact us - we love to help you in your research process. 

Kem-En-Tec Nordic A/S - Competent Bioscience since 1987

Name: COBO Technologies - Quality Control Genome Editing
Description:
COBO Technologies is a fast growing company based in Copenhagen, Denmark, that is specialised in products and services for QC of CRISPR modified cells and animals.

The INDEL Profiling Platform - CIPPTM, for detailed DNA mutation analysis, was launched in December 2017 and in January 2019 the company launched, PIPPR, for extensive Protein/Proteome Expression profiling using label-free LC-MS.

COBO Technologies support today customers globally in both the research and clinical fields.

Name: Backyard Creators
Description: Revolutionizing Hearing Solutions with Bionic Ear Technology

Name: Akasi Pharma
Description: At Akasi Pharma, we are developing novel peptide-based therapeutics to treat peripheral pain conditions

Name: Zymenex
Description:
Zymenex is a Scandinavian biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of novel enzyme replacement therapies for the treatment of life-threatening, rare genetic diseases. 

Zymenex is developing several human recombinant enzymes that can be used for therapy within specific disease areas. The products are expected to be able to help patients, who today have serious handicaps, reduced quality of life and a markedly reduced life expectancy. Enzyme replacement therapy is a well-known treatment method and there are a number of products on the market today that validates the company concept. 

The company’s Research and Development focuses on Lysosomal Storage Diseases, which is a common name for human diseases, where the ability of the human body to break down specific molecules in the lysosomes in the cells is reduced or impaired. The diseases most often affect children, they are lethal and there is no therapy available today.

Name: Ceremedy Aps
Description:
Ceremedy is a Copenhagen-based biotech company focused on drug discovery for the treatment of CNS disorders. The company was founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the University of Copenhagen.

Ceremedy’s team strives to develop new treatments for CNS disorders by targeting an important brain protein with a broad range of implications for treating CNS disorders. Backed with medicinal chemistry, pharmacology and neuroscience experience, we aim to facilitate the full process from idea to drug candidate.

Name: Lifebloom
Description:
We believe healthy skin and hair begin long before wrinkles appear or hair starts to thin.

They begin with the ability of cells to repair, regenerate, and maintain themselves over decades. And that ability depends on energy.

We develop human-native actives that support the cellular energy systems underlying healthy aging. Our molecules are sourced from cyanobacteria, ancient organisms that have spent billions of years converting sunlight and carbon dioxide into biological function.

By connecting nature’s oldest technology with modern biotechnology, we are creating the foundation for a new generation of longevity-focused personal care.

Name: The Plant Bioengineering Group
Description:
We need to produce nutritious and accessible food for our growing population without exhausting our planet and its people. The vision of the Plant Bioengineering group is to bridge molecular, agricultural, and food sciences to bioengineer resilient local wild plants into the crops of the future.

We are funded by an Emerging Investigator grant from the Novo Nordisk Foundation and are based in the Department of Plant and Environmental Sciences at the University of Copenhagen.

Name: BioColor
Description: Natural Colors by Fermentation

Name: BiOrigin
Description: BiOrigin provides different types of strategic and operational support to companies and projects in order to help them steer through the critical start-up and subsequent growth phase.

Name: RefLab
Description:
RefLab is a Danish biotech company located in Copenhagen founded in 1991 as a spin-off of Lundbeck and now a member of R-Biopharm group in Germany.

RefLab has proven track record with several big pharma companies together with established scientific collaborations with national and international universities and hospitals.

We offer clinical sample testing for chronic spontanous urticaria and 
preclinical contract research within PK/PD, translational studies assessing potential hypersensitivity and toxicological effects as well as drug metabolism studies in a human ex vivo immune model. RefLab has a pre-existing ethical clearance, no time delays for project start-up.

Applications for RefLab human ex vivo skin-based immune model is:
Pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics
Translational studies – from animal to man
Hypersensitivity reactions to pre-clinical drugs
Drug metabolism in human skin
Cytokine profiling and inflammatory responses
Protein detection and assessment of biological activity

RefLab also has an accredited Service Laboratory with extensive expertise in drug allergy and chronic urticaria testing, serving hospitals, clinics, allergy, immunology & dermatology specialists.

Please also find us on Scientist.com: https://app.scientist.com/domain_switcher?redirect=/providers/reflab-aps

Name: Proxi Biotech
Description:
Proxi Biotech develops a bacteria-resistant vaccine to treat multi-drug-resistant bacterial infections. Its BACTOVAC platform technology detoxifies bacterial toxins and kills multi-drug-resistant bacteria.

It was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Name: Yngvi Bio
Description:
(fml. NanoGuard Crop Solutions)

At Yngvi Bio, we safeguard crops worldwide with targeted, protein-based pest control - engineered for stability, sustainability, and effectiveness

Name: Ibnova Therapeutics
Description: At Ibnova, we’re building the next frontier of heart repair with our vascularized engineered heart tissue patches. Our goal is to transform the trajectory of heart disease for patients who continue to decline despite today’s best drugs and devices.

Name: Cell to Cure ApS
Description:
Cell2Cure ApS will provide patients, physicians and health care systems around the word with easy to use “off-the-shelf” highly effective and safe stem cell products for the treatment of patients with a wide range of diseases.

Cell2Cure is developing stem cell products, that are applied in promising new therapeutic concepts for treatment of several diseases. Pre-clinical studies and clinical phase I and II trials have demonstrated that our stem cell product can be used for treatment of heart diseases and tissue regeneration. Cell2Cure stem cell products are being clinically tested in a wide range of disease indications, where inflammation and tissue regeneration plays a role, and in prevention of organ transplant rejection.

Name: VPCIR Biosciences
Description: With our patented technology we make it possible to detect living pathogens in saliva resulting in easy, precise and cheap Tuberculosis testing – and more lives saved.

Name: Zyneyro
Description:
Zyneyro is a spin-out from the University of Copenhagen and Marigold Innovation developing next-generation therapies for chronic pain without the typical side effects. 

Built on 15 years of pioneering neuroscience research, our PICK1-targeting platform addresses the neuronal changes driving chronic pain. 

Our lead peptide program, ZYN01, aims to deliver rapid, reversible and safer pain relief without the limitations of current treatments.

Name: Healthycrop
Description:
At Healthycrop we believe in a green future and to support that we specialize in developing economically important agricultural crops that are naturally resistant to fungal infections, thereby enabling fungicide-free agriculture.
The resistance entails that the pre-harvest use of fungicides is reduced, and crops are not contaminated, pre- or post-harvest, with fungal toxins that are hazardous to animals and humans.

Name: Raven biosciences
Description:
We use cutting-edge in-silico technologies to design molecules of all modalities – small molecules, peptides, antibodies, enzymes, proteins, and nucleotides.

Our domain experts combine technologies from bioinformatics, cheminformatics, computational chemistry, high-performance computing and machine learning to bring the power of AI to your business needs.

Many companies struggle to adopt AI technologies as they do not have internal resources necessary to develop and manage advanced analysis solutions. Raven biosciences gives your business fast access to otherwise inaccessible AI technology and allow you to be part of the AI revolution in biotech with solutions that maximize the impact and value creation in your company.

We provide turn-key solutions with computational infrastructure for even the most demanding applications in life-science thereby alleviating the need to invest in expensive infrastructure or to build large specialized internal IT departments.

Name: Fermentationexperts
Description:
Fermentationexperts is an innovative company with operations in Europe and the United States. We believe that fermentation is the feeding technology of the future, and we continue to develop new areas where fermentation makes sense – for the individual farmer’s finances, for the health of their herds, and for the environment. Our strategy is to be located close to the raw materials so that we can keep our production costs as low as possible and remain highly competitive on the market. Throughout its history, Fermentationexperts has worked hard to build up knowledge about fermentation, both in theory and in practice. Our goal is to be present where fermented protein feed has its eligibility and where we have relatively easy access to raw materials. We aim to keep our production and logistic costs low. 

Moreover, we focus on involvement in projects where e.g. new types of raw materials and production methods are investigated that have a possibility to take our approach a step further. 

Make use of our knowledge to optimize your feeding operations. Take a tour around our web pages where you can find more information about our approach to fermentation and why we believe that this is the feeding technology of the future. Our goal is to minimize the use of antibiotics among pig and poultry farmers and improve the gut health of the animals. 
- we know how to get there.

Name: Formula Lab ApS
Description:
Who We Are
A highly specialized CRO focused on injectable peptide & protein drug product development.

What We Do

Design tailored lab-scale development programs

Identify the best-suited formulations through science & industry insight

Ensure clinical readiness without compromising on quality or patient safety

How We Deliver

Rigorous experimental design

Advanced analytics

Reliable execution and data-driven decisions

Our Goal
To transform innovation into safe, effective drug products ready for clinical development.

Name: SQALE
Description: SQALE is on a mission to empower food innovators by making their biomanufacturing processes profitable at scale.

Name: Dandelion
Description: Encoding the molecular fingerprint of biofluids to build the data layer for biological AI.

Name: Synuca Therapeutics
Description:
Synuca Therapeutics combines decades of groundbreaking research in P-type ATPases and neuroscience from Aarhus University to propose a novel disease-modifying treatment for patients suffering from Parkinson's Disease and associated disorders.
By targeting the SERCA calcium transporter, our first-in-class small molecules salvage the root disease cause by repairing the neuronal calcium imbalances caused by pathological α-Synuclein brain species.

Name: Myco4food
Description:
The global demand for protein will significantly increase over the coming years, due to the growing global population and the increasing standards of living. We provide a solution that will help counter this giant challenge.
 
We valorize organic residuals from the food and agricultural sector by transforming organic waste products into protein-rich and nutritious food ingredients. We do this by growing edible filamentous fungi on organic waste products in a solid-state fermentation (SSF) process with minimal water and energy consumption. This increases the circularity and sustainability of our food production systems. Through the fermentation process, protein content and quality are increased, and a meat-like taste is added to the final fermented product.

Name: SBE DTU
Description:
The Society for Biological Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark (SBE DTU) is a student organization by students for students. 

SBE DTU’s primary objective is to integrate biology, engineering, and innovation while creating national and international networks between students, universities, and the Industry. We aim to inspire students to get more involved in their studies, to aim even higher, and to consider their future. 

SBE DTU arranges numerous events with the objectives in mind.
Location: Kongens Lyngby, Capital City Region, Denmark

Name: XY Therapeutics
Description:
XY Therapeutics is based on more than 10 years of research from Kingdom Hospital in Copenhagen Denmark, with the focus on developing new treatment solutions for infertile couples. 

XY Therapeutics is developing a novel medical treatment for male infertility based on unique science demonstrating an important role of the RANKL/RANK/OPG pathway in the reproductive organs. The proprietary treatment has been shown to increase sperm production and function in preclinical and two clinical studies including a randomized clinical trial of infertile men. The treatment is safe and only a single injection is required to observe the expected effect.

There exist many causes for male infertility and although not all infertile men can be helped with this treatment, XY Therapeutics has identified and patented a biomarker that can select the men who will benefit from this treatment. This biomarker is currently being developed into a companion diagnostic that within minutes can allow clinicians and fertility experts to select the infertile men that will receive the treatment.

Currently, XY Therapeutics treatment is being tested in a Phase 2A trial, and expected positive result will provide a significant breakthrough in a field where there currently exists only very few available treatments for select subgroups of male infertility.

It is undoubtful that the innovation, will have a very broad impact on several aspects of citizens suffering from infertility from personal, societal and economic impact.

Visit us at: xytherapeutics.dk

Name: MSCA DN MICROSUNSET
Description:
MICROSUNSET is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network, funded by the European Union (Horizon Europe). MICROSUNSET started on the 1st of January 2026 and will run until the 31st of December 2029.
MICROSUNSET brings together 7 Beneficiaries and 14 associated partners from 9 countries, with the goal to train young scientists in micronutrients (vitamin and mineral) research to ensure that future sustainable diets provide these essential nutrients to promote healthy lives for populations globally.
MICROSUNSET will train 12 doctoral candidates through research stays, secondments and training events using an interdisciplinary and intersectoral training programme.

MICROSUNSET is funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe Research and Innovation programme, under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (Grant Agreement number 101226907).

Name: Yngvik ApS
Description: At Yngvik, we are combining the strength of fermentation and GMO to manufacture the next generation of biopolymers to advance a more responsible future.

Name: Probmet Therapeutics
Description: Probmet is a precision oncology therapeutics company that is developing targeted treatments for breast cancer brain metastatic patients. The team will lead the development of breakthrough targeted therapies for metastatic breast cancer in the brain, a devastating disease that currently has limited treatment options.

Name: Gly-it
Description:
We can help you to use glycosylation to improve:

– Taste
– Toxicity
– Solubility
– Absorption
– Metabolism
– Blood-brain barrier transmission

Name: Accelerbiotics
Description:
Accelerbiotics was founded April 2019 as spinout from Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Biosustainability, Technical University of Denmark.

We at Accelerbiotics provide affordable high-throughput sustainable solutions for the huge bottlenecks that synthetic biology and biotech industry are suffering from. Our solutions accelerate development in biotechnology and life science field.

At Accelerbiotics we have addressed the huge bottlenecks of low throughput, the high cost and sustainability issues associated with applications of electrophoresis, purification and electrotransfection/electroporation in the biotechnology field.

Rising incidence of cancer, infectious diseases, and genetic disorders; recent advances in personalized medicine; growth in funding for research on genomic, proteomic, metabolomics; growing number of industry-academia research collaborations on biosustainability; growing number of biotech sustainable microbial cell factories; and growth in the number of clinical, forensic, and research laboratories are the major factors driving the market growth of the electrophoresis, purification and electrotransfection.

In the light of the strong need of new and improved high-throughput sustainable affordable solutions, we have developed the following 4 technologies and protected them with below 4 patents: 

1- Electrophoresis assembly and methods EU EP20210257.0 

2- Methods, assembly and system for high-throughput, parallel monitoring of reaction systems . Patent No:  EP20191858.8 
 
3- ELECTROPHORESIS ASSEMBLY . Patent No: WO2020079211 A1
 
4- METHODS FOR EXTRACTION OF MOLECULES . Patent No: WO2020079220 A1

Name: OZQA
Description:
OZQA delivers turnkey quality systems and SOP templates for biotech, pharma, and life science companies. From ready-to-use documentation to full implementation and training. We make compliance simple.

We support organisations with GxP, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and EU Pharmacovigilance, combining structured documentation, practical consulting, and real inspection experience.
Our focus is on clear, proportionate, and usable quality systems, particularly for companies working with outsourced or lean operating models.

Name: OceanWide Seaweed ApS
Description:
At OceanWide Seaweed, we are dedicated to creating a sustainable future. Our mission is to address climate change and revolutionize seaweed production through our seaweed hatchery.
We specialize in Palmaria Palmata, a type of seaweed with the potential to drive global transformation. Our newly developed hatchery equipment for Palmaria Palmata is the result of extensive research and rigorous testing, ensuring optimal production and sustainability.

Contact us at: Contact@oceanwideseaweed.com

Name: CerCell A/S
Description:
CerCell was founded 2009 to market the world only configurable Single-Use-Bioreactor portfolio for up-stream expression of antibodies and vaccine to the pharmaceutical industry. The focus is to supply end-users, contractors and Process-Control-System (PCS) manufacturers with creative, un-conventional, fully customisable, ready to use and visionary single-use products, such as:

- Batch Single-Use-Bioreactor (SUB) for cultivation
- Fed-batch Single-Use-Bioreactor (SUB) for cultivation
- Single-Use-Fermenter (SUF) for fermentation
- Single-Use-Mixer (SUM) for mRNA, viral vector, etc manufacturing
- Perfusion SUBs incl Levitronix centrifugal pump

World only supplier based on unique on-line "Configurator Tool" for SUB and SUF products.

All products replacing any of the traditional glass/steel (STR). Scalable SUBs, SUFs, SUMs and P-SUBs ranging from 500 ml to 30 liter Vessel Volume. Easily controlled by existing PCS.

CerCell belongs to Stobbe Group

Name: Levinsen A/S
Description:
I Levinsen A/S arbejder vi for at levere de bedste skov-, løv- og buskfrø til kunderne hvert år.

Busk-, løv- og skovfrø er naturprodukter, og derfor påvirkes det årlige høstresultat af udsving i vækstforhold, vejr og vind. Derfor arbejder vi også med en lagerstrategi på vore største produktgrupper indenfor såvel nåletræ, som løvtræ og buskfrø.

I løbet af de sidste par år har vi sikret leverance af Nordmannsgranfrø fra Georgien, ved at skaffe 10- og 20-årige høstlicenser til udvalgte lokaliteter i Ambrolauri og Borjomi Skovdistrikter. Vi henter også frø i udvalgte lokaliteter i Apsheronsk Skovdistrikt, hvilket er sikret gennem aftaler med de regionale myndigheder. 

Levinsen har gennem mange år, også i tidligere firmakonstellationer, arbejdet med dokumentation af provenienssikkerheden for det frø vi importerer til Danmark og sender videre til kunder herhjemme og i udlandet. 

Det kvalitetssikringssystem, som vi igennem en årrække har oparbejdet og udviklet, er vi i gang med at ISO-certificere sammen med de procedurer omkring arbejdsvilkår og socialt ansvar, som vi anvender for vores udenlandske arbejdskraft.

Vi samarbejder med en række private skovejere i Danmark og udlandet om høst, forarbejdning og levering af kvalitetsfrø fra kårede bevoksninger og udpegede frøkilder. Vi arbejder kontinuerligt på at tilbyde de bedste frøkilder, herunder indsamle erfaringer fra praktikere og opsøge nyt materiale, hvor behovet viser sig.

Vi har opbygget egne frøkilder af Nordmannsgran i Danmark, og i de senere år har vi etableret indsamling af diverse løv- og buskfrøarter rundt omkring i Danmark i samarbejde med private lodsejere. 

I dialog med fagfolk - bl.a. Frøkildeudvalget og KU-LIFE - har vi lagt vægt på genetisk brede frøkilder, som hører hjemme i den danske flora, og samtidig møder vore kunders behov.

Name: QuantumCell
Description: At QuantumCell, we are rewriting the rules of drug discovery and we're just getting started. We are a dynamic biology company on a mission to decode and defeat the most complex brain disorders of our time. By converging next-generation sensing technologies, autonomous robotics, and cutting-edge AI, we are building the world's first high-fidelity virtual cell and virtual system model: a mechanistically anchored simulation of human biology that can predict how drugs will behave in a patient before a single trial is run. Anchored by world-class scientific partnerships and access to elite computational infrastructure, we generate spatiotemporal biological data at a scale and resolution no one has achieved before. This isn't incremental science. It's a fundamental shift from reductionist biology to a true systems-level understanding of the human brain, and we are looking for bold, brilliant people to help us build it.

Name: STRONG-UR
Description:
STRONG-UR comes to revolutionise the repair of damaged tissue by creating advanced bioprinted tissue structures. This project focuses on the treatment of male urethral strictures which affect a significant proportion of men, causing both physical complications and psychological distress, and challenging healthcare resources. With specifically designed 3D bioprinter components and biomaterials, STRONG-UR seeks to make personalised, engineered tissue available for medical use. 

The team behind STRONG-UR includes specialists in cell biology, biomaterials, 3D printing, and urology from leading organisations including Aalborg University (coordinator), Tampere University, Ghent University, Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore and University Medical Center Utrecht, alongside industry leaders in bioink formulation, medical device manufacturing, and regulatory management such as 4Tissue, Wellspect AB, Brinter, and Adbioink Biosystem Technology. Additionally, the European Association of Urology and META Group provide dissemination expertise to support STRONG-UR's communication and outreach objectives. 

STRONG-UR is funded by the Horizon Europe programme.

Name: Danish Myo Technology A/S (DMT)
Description:
Danish Myo Technology A/S — DMT — develops and manufactures precision research systems for ex vivo physiology, vascular function, muscle contraction, and pharmacology studies.

For more than 40 years, DMT has supported researchers worldwide with Wire Myograph, Pressure Myograph, Organ Bath, and Muscle Strip Systems designed to generate reliable, reproducible functional data from isolated vessels, smooth muscle, skeletal muscle, cardiac tissue, and other tissue preparations.

Our systems combine mechanical engineering, electronics, software, and application expertise in integrated platforms for academic, clinical, pharmaceutical, and contract research laboratories.

DMT works closely with the global research community to provide robust instrumentation, intuitive software, installation, hands-on training, and long-term support for modern ex vivo research.

Name: CoboSci - Biomedical Research
Description:
CoboSci was founded in January 2017 and is working as an European commercial partner agent for a selection of leading Life Science companies within the BioMedical Research and Drug Discovery segments.

We have more than 20 years experience supporting these segments with innovative and unique products and services.

Our headquarter is located in Copenhagen, Denmark, in the center of one of Europe ́s most innovative Life Science clusters, where we today support the major hospitals and universities, more than 150 biotech ́s and several of the worlds leading pharma companies.

Name: BioLib
Description: BioLib is integrating cutting-edge artificial intelligence with the world of biological data science. Our mission is monumental: to harness the power of machine learning and innovative technologies to revolutionize scientific discovery and drug development. By developing a state-of-the-art cloud platform and proprietary database technologies, we enable the most efficient use of biological data, setting the stage for groundbreaking advancements in medicine.

Name: LAB Denmark
Description:
We have changed names! We are now called Berner lab and you can find our new LinkedInaccount here: linkedin.com/company/berner-lab.

Name: Transcriptomic Insights
Description:
Transcriptomic Insights is a Copenhagen-based CRO providing end-to-end RNA sequencing services for life science research across industry and academia. We connect experimental workflows, advanced data analysis and biological interpretation to empower research in biology and disease.

Transcriptomics Insights couples Bulk RNA-seq, Single-cell RNA-seq and Spatial transcriptomics with advanced project-tailored data analysis to provide clear and understandable insights into complex biology. 

Built on extensive experience working with RNAseq across numerous disease areas in both industry and academic context, Transcriptomic Insights is on a mission to make modern RNA-seq available and actionable for all. 

Find us at www.trins.dk

Name: Tailorzyme Aps
Description:
Tailorzyme custom develop enzyme solution for your needs e.g. within Food & Beverage, based on high quality enzymes from well-recognised suppliers globally.
With more than 100 years of enzyme application know-how, we have proven to numerous customers that our application and process capabilities makes a difference and create significant value.
Being a small and flexible organisation we are ready to serve you.

Name: ACTPAC Project
Description:
ACTPAC aims to establish a complete industry-viable transformation route for the conversion of non-degradable plastic wastes into high value chemicals as well as to synthesise biodegradable polyesters with PE-like properties. Thus, a zero-pollution, bio-based solution to the existing environmental challenge is created, by keeping plastic wastes out of the environment, while reclaiming their values for a better circular bioeconomy. To this end, a series of technologies and innovative chemo-/biological transformation systems will be developed and demonstrated at pilot scale. Two novel arrays of monomers value-added chemicals with differing chain lengths will be developed. Correspondingly, a broad spectrum of polymer products with different properties and thus suitable for various application will be produced. 

Funded by the European Union. Views and opinions expressed are however those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or European Research Executive Agency. Neither the European Union nor the granting authority can be held responsible for them.

Name: PANORAMIX-h2020
Description:
The goal of PANORAMIX is to provide new tools for risk assessments of complex real-life mixtures for the protection of European citizens and the environment.
This project has received funding from the European Union's Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under Grant Agreement 101036631

Name: Project BIO-Boost
Description: The overall objectives of the BIOBoost project are to increase the latent potential of the participating innovation agencies, to learn from leading innovator regions, and to cement this knowledge and experience in the organisations, building and expanding networks, expanding the cooperation and enlarging the participation of more diverse innovation stakeholders and territories to existing successful initiatives in the bioeconomy, including agri-food, forestry, bio-based chemicals, materials and products, and bioenergy. The partnership will implement a range of activities via peer-to-peer learning, including study visits and staff exchanges, to develop closer relationships within the partnership, and with the wider regional innovation ecosystems, as well as to learn improved innovation support measures. These will be cemented via operational work to build and develop innovation ecosystems and SMEs via hackathons and challenges (160 organisations involved), by providing direct SME support on innovation management (24 crossborder KAM cases), and helping widening country SMEs towards financing of innovation projects (50+ cases). Over 450 SMEs will be engaged with during the implementation of the project, which will include active cooperation with 20 other innovation ecosystems. BIOBoost connects 7 homogenous EU regions in terms of similarities of RIS3 and S3 Platform synergies related to bioeconomy and digitalisation. The multidisciplinary partnership has been strategically selected, to work in an inclusive and interactive bottom-up process, to discover potential new activities, and identify new opportunities that emerge from this interaction. Despite the homogeneity in terms of regional smart specialisation, the consortium consists of partners with a wide variety of complementary skills and experience, covering a wide geographical area and with considerable economic, social and environmental differences.

Name: Biotrino
Description:
Did you know that one kg of protein from beef leaves the same footprint as flying London – New York, and requires around 30kg of corn to produce?

The whole agriculture- and farming industry is inefficient and broken – we are working hard to fix this.

At Biotrino we are passionate about utilizing microorganisms to produce proteins and fats. They do this far faster and more efficient than animals and plants – without using any toxins.

Name: GreenCow Biosolutions
Description:
GreenCow Biosolutions is an industrial biotech company developing microbial biosolutions that convert cow methane into nutritional value directly in the rumen.

Our biological methane conversion platform is designed to integrate into existing feed systems, creating value for farmers, the dairy industry and the climate.

We combine microbial innovation with scalable feed-system integration to enable partner-led global deployment.

Turning cow methane into value, globally.

Name: Inter Biosolutions
Description: Our flagship product, AnaCardex, is a natural, affordable, and highly effective feed additive for cattle that has demonstrated potential to reduce ruminant methane emissions by 50% or more, thereby cutting greenhouse gas emissions (GHG) without compromising farmer productivity or profitability. By extracting anacardic acid, the bioactive compound in AnaCardex, from cashew nut shell liquid (CNSL), we turn yesterday’s waste problem into tomorrow’s climate solution.

Name: Ovodan Biotech A/S
Description:
Ovodan Biotech A/S develops high-affinity antibodies for scientific research and diagnostic industries. Based on our unique one-step purification technology we provide customers with ready-to-use polyclonal antibodies targeted toward catalogue biomarkers and custom-made targets. 

Since 2011 we have served the market with high quality chicken immunoglobulin Y (IgY) purified from egg yolk. Immunization of chickens offers a less stressful and a non-invasive method as known from mammal immunization. It only requires daily collection of eggs, where the yolks contain the valuable antibodies.

To ensure a high-quality result, Ovodan Biotech has developed a state-of-the-art technology that offers affinity purified polyclonal chicken antibody (IgY), where more than 99% of the antibodies being highly antigen specific. Furthermore, the process is efficient and optimized for bulk production.

At Ovodan Biotech A/S we continuously strive to maintain a catalogue of antibodies toward relevant targets, but we also offer contract immunization for specific targets for science research and diagnostics. 

Please do not hesitate to contact us or for any specific requests or to discuss your possibilities within our state-of-the-art technology. 
customerservice@ovodanbiotech.com

Ownership and Partnerships:
Ovodan Biotech A/S was founded in 2011 (as Sanovo Biotech A/S) and is owned and funded through THORNICO A/S, a company with more than 70 years of experience in the egg business, and the largest provider of lysozyme in Europe. Ovodan Biotech A/S also enjoys R&D funding from public-private partnership programs, and benefits from strong ties to Danish universities and feed and egg industry partners. Learn more about THORNICO via www.thornico.com.

Name: Ranger Biotechnologies A/S
Description:
In may 2018 Ranger Biotechnologies acquired all assets including the Blockmir Technology platform from former Mirrx Therapeutics. Today the Blockmir Technology is part of a strategic alliance between Ranger and MJJ Biotechnologies, Guangdong, PRC.

The technology uses short highly modified oligonucleotides – Blockmirs – to block specific miRNA binding sites on individual mRNAs. This achieves gene specific upregulation on protein level and sets the Blockmir Technology apart from most other therapeutic modalities which aim to antagonize mRNA or protein activity. Blockmirs are agonists of gene expression and lead to physiologic upregulation of protein levels.

The Blockmir Technology is covered by a broad and dominant portfolio of issued patents. The patent estate covers the target mRNAs of more than 300 miRNAs – which means several thousands of different target mRNAs that can be upregulated individually.

Upregulation of therapeutically relevant proteins is applicable in a wide range of diseases spanning from cancer to rare genetic and metabolic disorders where even a small upregulation of a single protein can mean a world of difference for the patients.

Together with MJJ Biotechnologies we are focused on developing new medicines for diseases of the liver, the CNS and the eye.

Name: Omics Studio
Description: At Omics Studio, we deliver innovative bioinformatics software solutions that make complex omics data analysis simple and effective. With a focus on usability and precision, our platform helps researchers and organizations accelerate discoveries and drive impactful outcomes.

Name: Fosgerau Consult ApS
Description:
Fosgerau Consult (FC) is a small and flexible team of seasoned professionals that aims to deliver personal consulting within Drug Development processes and Life Science business development. Name: Bio Clean Carbon
Description:
Bio Clean Carbon is redefining wastewater treatment by turning it into a carbon-capturing and nutrient-recycling process. Using the natural capabilities of cyanobacteria, we operate open pond systems within wastewater facilities to capture CO2 from the air and absorb nitrogen and phosphorus through photosynthesis. This process reduces greenhouse gases while recovering valuable nutrients that would otherwise cause eutrophication.

Our cyanobacteria thrive even in harsh Nordic climates, making the system highly energy-efficient and compatible with existing pond infrastructure. The resulting biomass is converted into biochar through a low-energy pyrolysis process, locking carbon long-term and producing useful byproducts like pyrolysis gas and nutrient-rich biochar. The approach not only cuts emissions and pollution but also creates new revenue streams through CO2, nitrogen, and phosphorus recovery.

The Bio Clean Carbon solution stands out for its scalability, low energy demand, and easy integration with current wastewater facilities, delivering both economic and environmental benefits. Our work supports global sustainability goals (SDGs 6, 12, 13, and 15) and contributes directly to climate change mitigation and pollution reduction.

We’ve completed successful pilot tests with municipal and industrial partners—achieving over 90% phosphate and 99% ammonium capture, mitigating nutrient runoff and eutrophication in aquatic ecosystems, and demonstrating CO2 uptake seven times greater than conventional algae systems. In early 2026, we’ll begin pyrolysis trials with universities and farmers to confirm biochar’s fertilization potential.  

Bio Clean Carbon represents a transformative step toward circular, sustainable wastewater management. Join us in advancing climate protection through innovative, nature-based solutions.

Name: Frisenette ApS
Description:
Frisenette ApS er et danskejet firma med både lokal forankring og et globalt udsyn.

Vores styrke er forståelsen for vores mange kunders behov og ønsker – disse reagerer vi omgående på.

Vi bestræber os på at kunne levere de rigtige produkter på rette tidspunkt og samtidig være imødekommende over for vores kunder og deres behov.

I tæt på et århundrede, har vi gjort vores bedste for at indfri markedets behov til enhver tid. Det kan være brugen af et papirfilter til en simpel adskillelse, til behovet for et spektrofotometer, hvor præcision er betydningsfuld.

Vores sortiment er forbrugsartikler til stort set alle typer offentlige og private laboratorier og består af filtre, filtreringsudstyr, plast- og glasvarer og testudstyr til vandanalyser m.v.

Udover at levere til laboratorier herhjemme, eksporter vi også dele af vores sortiment, dels til slutbrugere, men også en betydelig del til forhandlere i hele Europa og omkringliggende lande.

Vi markedsfører vores egne registrerede varemærker; Q-Max sprøjtefiltre og MontaMil membranfiltre globalt som en del af eget sortiment. Gennem hele vores eksistens har vi sammenarbejdet med kendte producenter.

Vores største partnere i dag er det japanske firma ADVANTEC Toyo Roshi Kaisha, Macherey-Nagel GmbH i Tyskland, Nerbe Plus ligeledes i Tyskland, DELTALAB i Spanien, Rocker Scientific i Taiwan og mange flere.

Efter ca. 40 år med domicil nord for København, ca. 33 år i Ebeltoft, har vi nu siden 2005 haft hjemme i Knebel på Mols, hvor vi har i alt 1.900 m2 under tag fordelt på administration, produktionslokaler og ca. 1.100 m2 lagerfaciliteter.

Name: BioScavenge
Description:
BioScavenge delivers solutions supporting the adoption of circular economy principles in industrial production, through value creation from downstream process segments. 

Together with our customers, we develop and maintain sustainable process solutions, to minimize their environmental impact by reducing waste generation, and achieving general performance improvements. 

We mainly work with complex challenges in chemical, tanning, food, biotech and pharma industries, where our knowledge on recovery and valorization of waste streams brings value. 

Our technological solutions are industry-proven, sustainable, modular and economically viable. We deliver fast no-nonsense analytics, and advice our clients on how to recover and re-cycle process waste streams efficiently. Together we find the best way forward to implementation. 

Our customers are ambitious industrial market leaders that care about their products, customers, the environment and their social responsibility.

Bioscavenge was established in February 2017, as a spin-out of the biotech cluster BIOPRO and DTU Chemical Engineering.

Name: ISD-Immunotech
Description: ISD Immunotech is developing STING modulators to treat severe Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or Lupus by targeting the STING pathway. SLE is a complex and devastating autoimmune disease with few to no good options for treatment especially for the most severe patients. STimulator of INterferon Gene (STING) is a target that controls innate immunity and has shown to be overactive in severe SLE making it an exciting new therapeutic target for SLE.

Name: DTU Biobuilders
Description: DTU Biobuilders aim to solve real life problems with synthetic biology as the main driver. The team of students is put together on a yearly basis and every year DTU Biobuilders participate in the International Genetically Engineered Machine (iGEM) competition, which is the largest synthetic biology competition in the world. DTU Biobuilders’ activities are primarily driven by students, with the support of several faculty supervisors.

Name: ArcanaBio
Description: At Arcanabio, we're developing a new biophotonics platform that revolutionizes continuous biomarker detection. Our goal is to help people monitor their everyday health, prevent disease, and advance next-generation proteomics.

Name: EnteroTarget
Description:
EnteroTarget is a clinical stage company founded in 2018 based on an exclusive license to the patent “Rectal Insulin for treatment of inflammatory bowel disease”, which is granted in 15 European countries and in the US (pending in Canada). The patent is owned by University of Copenhagen and has two EnteroTarget founders among the inventors.

EnteroTarget’s product is named Enterocalm, which has topically acting insulin as the active pharmaceutical ingredient. The first version is EnteroCalm Enema which is to be followed by an orally administered version delivering topically acting insulin to the colon utilizing EnteroTarget’s proprietary capsule technology, the EnteroShuttle (patent pending).

We are partnering up with investors to bring the therapy to market with pouchitis and ulcerative colitis as the primary medical indications and with Crohn’s disease as a potential additional indication. 

Currently, we are running phase 1 clinical trials and are preparing for a clinical phase 2 to meet the milestones in our ambitious business plan.

Name: Hazel Therapeutics
Description:
Hazel Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing localized RNA medicines for osteoarthritis.

The company combines antisense oligonucleotide therapeutics with the proprietary BioMATA delivery platform to enable sustained release and prolonged tissue exposure following local administration.

Hazel Therapeutics is a spin-out from the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and is advancing disease-modifying RNA therapies targeting key drivers of joint degeneration

Name: EnXylaScope
Description:
The key aim of EnXylaScope is to widen the scope and industrial potential of xylan debranching enzymes by developing enzymes with high catalytic activity and wide operation conditions, thereby demonstrate their ability to make xylan a platform polymer for applications in a variety of consumer products, with 6 products, covering 3 market sectors (personal care, cosmetics and nutraceuticals), formulated, tested, and optimised during the project.

Name: DNA Technology A/S
Description:
Excellence in the manufacture of Oligonucleotides

Established in Aarhus, Denmark in 1992, DNA Technology A/S (DNA Technology) is a leading provider of custom-manufactured synthetic oligonucleotides in the Nordic countries. A primary focus of our company is the production of highly-modified synthetic DNA and RNA to serve life science research and healthcare markets. We are currently ISO 9001:2008 certified, and first certified to the ISO 9002 standard in 1997

DNA Technology manufactures custom oligonucleotides of the Highest Quality. The company specializes in synthesis of innovative modifications, long and highly purified oligonucleotides as well as large scale HQ synthesis for a number of well-known Biotech Companies. 

You can learn more about us at www.dna-technology.dk

Name: Maripure
Description:
Biosolutions promise immense potential by harnessing nature’s principles through science, technology, and engineering to develop and manufacture industrial solutions. We believe that biosolutions work with people and the planet, and represent the path to price competitive, consistent, and verified solutions that remove barriers to implementation, and thus can create immense positive impact.

Our biosolutions operate at the nexus of climate tech, blue biotech and agrifood systems and are an instrument of the green transition. 

Our nature design tool is the amazing resource of macroalgae [seaweed] and its diverse biochemistry.

Name: Khodosevich Lab
Description:
At the Khodosevich Lab, we are dedicated to understanding the development and function of brain cells and how their dysregulation contributes to neurological and psychiatric disorders, including schizophrenia.

Based at the Biotech Research & Innovation Centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen, our research combines advanced single-cell techniques, innovative mouse models, and spatial transcriptomics to explore the complexity of brain cell types and their interactions.

Our mission is to uncover the cellular and molecular mechanisms driving brain disorders, making the way for targeted therapeutic strategies.

Follow us to stay updated on our research, projects, and contributions to neuroscience!

Name: Sera Scandia A/S
Description:
Sera Scandia A/S is a Danish company dedicated to the production and distribution of products applied in Biotechnology and Nutrition, working through subsidiaries and associated companies across the world.

The group was founded in Venezuela in 1975 and later expanded across Latin America. Sera Scandia A/S became the holding company in 1992 and today holds subsidiaries in Latin America, U.S.A. and Europe, making it a leading supplier of animal sera for cell culture and natural ingredients for nutrition.

Name: Borregaard BioPlant
Description: Borregaard BioPlant er dedikeret til bæredygtig plantebeskyttelse.

Name: Aptamist ApS
Description:
At Aptamist we specialize in the development of cutting-edge aptamers for a wide range of applications including therapeutics, diagnostics, food analysis and basic research. 

Our mission
We are committed to advancing the field of aptamer technology and deliver innovative solutions that can revolutionize healthcare, agriculture and food quality.

Our story
Aptamist was born out of a desire to push the boundaries for molecular recognition and support local researchers and industry with aptamer services and expertises. Today, Aptamist collaborates with and supports customers and partners in DK, EU and US.

Team Aptamist
Our team is composed of professionals with more than 20 years of documented experience with aptamer development as well as deep expertise within nucleic acid and protein biochemistry, biophysics and both in vitro and in vivo applications.

Name: ÉTIQUETTE
Description: Étiquette is a biotech company helping wineries create premium alcohol-free wine through fermentation-first technology that prevents ethanol from forming. No dealcoholization, no added CAPEX, and a cleaner path to better flavor, lower energy use, and seamless production inside existing cellar operations.

Name: BioPhenyx
Description:
CRISPR-Select is a cutting-edge technology developed by BioPhenyx that utilizes CRISPR to evaluate the effects of genetic mutations, providing reliable insights into drug targets and patient responses.

BioPhenyx helps our customers determine drug targets and drug responses in a multitude of settings from the earliest target discovery to patient response to therapeutics.

Exceptional data on the role of molecular targets in disease etiology and their responsiveness to drug candidates are critical for better development of therapeutics. This will reduce attrition rates in development programs and clinical trials.

The BioPhenyx team has invented and developed the CRISPR-Select technology to generate unmatched data quality. We perform precise, fast (weeks), and quantitative analysis of a candidate drug target or a drug response in cells, where we introduce mutation(s) needed to address the question. This is done with no need for cell line generation and clonal selection.

Name: tasira
Description: We think that the next wave of sugar reduction will be won by solutions that ensure a clean taste, label appeal and formulation performance. This is why we are developing natural, clean-label sweeteners based on sweet proteins. Want to know more about how sweet proteins can improve your product? Reach out!

Your source for everything about molecular machines. Subscribe today and get the latest stories in your inbox!

Name: Kiox Pharmaceuticals
Description:
Kiox Pharma is developing treatments for rare lung diseases. We focus on diseases with no or limited treatment options caused by environmental and occupational factors. 
Our purpose and mission is to help as many as possible with a rare lung disease by breathing life into rare lung innovations.

Name: Translational Research Centre, Rigshospitalet
Description:
At Translational Research Centre, Rigshospitalet we do world-leading translational research that transforms basic science into clinical solutions for improved patient care and enhanced public health. We do this through international collaborations with both public and private sector partners, by housing state-of-the-art research facilities, by nurturing an attractive research environment, and by engaging with health care professionals and policy makers.   
We currently focus on areas such as headaches, migraine, sensory biology, bone diseases, and multiple sclerosis but welcome any group dedicated to translational research that shares our values. 
We value the strength of teamwork and have a collaborative and trustful working environment extending to all employees and students.  
We empower young researchers and have a vibrant research training community that thrives on trustful supervision and mentorship, curiosity, creativity, and intellectual rigor. 
We engage with the local and global community via public outreach, social media and news outlets, and involve all employees and students in this.

Name: Upfront Chromatography A/S
Description:
A recognized leader in the field of expanded bed chromatography (EBA), Upfront is a Danish company providing biomolecule (proteins & oligosaccharides) isolation and separation technology to the food & feed, industrial enzymes and life science sectors. 

Currently focusing on the dairy industry, Upfront is designing and implementing disruptive dairy solutions that enable dairies to benefit from businesses utilizing dairy ingredient products requiring high levels of purity and retaining native functionalities. By enabling high volume production of these types of products and enhancing the valorisation of diverse feed-streams, Upfront strives to deliver value to the customer's bottom line.

In addition to the dairy industry, EBA is well suited to extracting high value products from a variety of feed and waste streams in the sectors noted above.

The opportunities for new business models that impart added value to existing operations depend upon specific product requirements and existing or planned configurations.  Upfront encourages an open dialogue to create dedicated solutions tailored to your needs.

Name: Center for Biological Sequence Analysis
Description:
The Center for Biological Sequence Analysis (CBS) at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Department of Systems Biology, conducts basic research in the general fields of bioinformatics and systems biology. CBS represents one of the largest, multi-disciplinary basic research groups within bioinformatics and systems biology in academia in Europe. 

Research at CBS is conducted in 13 specialist research groups spanning the broad spectrum of research at the interface between computational biology and wet lab experimentation. 

CBS is highly active across the spectrum from molecular level disease systems biology, chemical biology, regulatory genomics, evolutionary analysis, and immunological bioinformatics to protein post-translational modifications and sorting. Activities span all kingdoms of life and also their interaction and co-existence, for example in projects on the bacterial flora in the human gut as it is studied using metagenomics and metatranscriptomics techniques. 

The center is also interfacing to the general area of medical informatics analyzing data from the healthcare sector, including text mining of electronic patient records and biobank questionnaires.

Since 1993 the center has been led by Professor Søren Brunak. Professor Ole Lund acts as the deputy director.

Name: Vironance
Description: Installed into the current HVAC systems as a filter, the Vironance inactivates the viruses by creating an electromagnetic environment.

Name: Naturbiogas Sode
Description:
Visionen for Naturbiogas Sode er at gøre Haderslev Næs til en del af den grønne omstilling. Området har mange landbrug, og Naturbiogas Sode er nøglen til, at de i fremtiden bliver CO2-neutrale, samtidig med at vi leverer bæredygtig og vedvarende energi til både forbrugere og erhvervsliv. 

Vi er stolte af at skabe et grønt alternativ til kul og olie og dermed bidrage til omstillingen fra fossile brændstoffer til vedvarende energi. 

Naturbiogas Sode producerer 19 mio m3 biogas årligt, og biogasanlægget er placeret på Hejsager Næsvej 137A, 6100 Haderslev med kort afstand til omkringliggende landbrug, der leverer hovedparten af biomassen.

Anlægget har en kapacitet på 200.000 tons biomasse per år, hvoraf 140.000 tons er husdyrgødning fra både kvæg, svin og høns, 24.000 tons er landbrugsafgrøder, hvoraf den største mængde er majs, mens de resterende tons er vegetabilske organiske restprodukter fra industrien, for eksempel glycerin, melasse og katoffelpulp.

Name: Idun Biologics ApS
Description:
We are an independent biotech start-up based in Aalborg, Denmark.  Our focus is the development of biological therapeutics for treating negative side effects of excessive caloric intake. Idun Biologics was founded in January 2023 by Clarisse Chiche-Lapierre and Frederik Teilfeldt Hansen. We have received non-dilutive funding from the Danish Innovation Foundation.

For more info, contact us at info@idunbiologics.com
Or visit our website www.idunbiologics.com

Name: You Do Bio
Description:
We are a provider of technologies to the life sciences field in Scandinavia (HQ in Denmark). New technologies and tools are as important to progress in research as ideas are. Technology can allow ideas to be tested, but also creates the space for previously impossible ideas to grow. 

You Do Bio specializes in tools used for scientific discovery in the life sciences. We actively work with tools providers to introduce their innovations to researchers. Our aim is to be the bridge between technology developers and those with the deepest need.

Name: Mutwil Lab
Description:
Plants evolved organs, specialized metabolites, and a myriad of physiological and molecular adaptive strategies to thrive in adverse environments. A better understanding of the genes and pathways behind these adaptive strategies would provide unprecedented knowledge of how plants evolve and how to engineer more stress-resilient crops with higher nutritional values. However, the function of most genes in the plant kingdom is unknown, constrained to only a handful of model organisms, or inferred by genomic approaches, which often cannot reveal which genes work together in a biological pathway. 

My long-term goal is to uncover the function and evolution of genes, stress resilience mechanisms, and specialized metabolic biosynthetic pathways of algae and land plants by a combination of large-scale, comparative experimental, and computational approaches.

Name: Loligo Systems
Description:
Loligo Systems develop and manufacture advanced research systems for measuring aquatic animal respiration, behavior, and swimming performance with scientific precision. Our swim tunnels, respirometry systems, custom chambers, and automated video tracking tools are trusted worldwide for generating high quality physiological and behavioral data.

While rooted in marine fish physiology >20 years ago, our technologies now power research across disciplines such as ecotoxicology, neuroscience, and biomedicine, where controlled environments and sensitive measurements are essential. Our solutions have likewise gained traction in respirometry of terrestrial organisms (e.g., Drosophila) and single cell suspensions (e.g., bacteria or algae).  

From oxygen consumption and locomotion to behavior and high throughput microplate assays, Loligo Systems help scientists accelerate discovery, standardize workflows, and produce reproducible results. Since the establishment of Loligo Systems in 2002, our solutions have been cited in >2.500 scientific publications, confirming the broad applicability and reliability of our products.  

Visit our website – www.loligosystems.com – for more information on our solutions, links to publications, video tutorials, and download of demo software.

Name: Swedish Biomimetics 3000 μLOT Technology
Description:
SB3000 μLOT Technology is dedicated to developing green manufacturing solutions for continuous manufacturing in the pharmaceutical industry and over the last few years has been developing its μLOT solid phase, continuous manufacturing platform for the manufacture of peptide medicines. 
The plan is to expand the μLOT technology into many other manufacturing applications in the future.

Name: VarCT Diagnostics
Description: VARCT Diagnostics is a MedTech company developing novel in-vitro cancer diagnostics based on the detection of oncofetal Chondroitin Sulfate, a tumor-specific glycosaminoglycan discovered by our founders in 2012 present in most cancers and in circulating tumor biomarkers.

Name: 1stBiome
Description:
We are 1stBiome, developing next-generation probiotics for a healthier future.

1stBiome is a gut-focused platform company engineering beneficial microbes to reduce low-grade inflammation and support metabolic health and longevity through next-generation dietary supplements.

We combine advanced microbiology, genetic engineering, and deep biological insight to create scalable, affordable nutritional solutions with multiple downstream health benefits.

Name: Analona Therapeutics
Description: Analona Therapeutics is leveraging cutting-edge research from a world-leading pancreatic cancer research group in the UK to develop groundbreaking antibody-based therapies that exploit metabolic cancer cell vulnerabilities.

Name: Incipiam Pharma
Description:
Incipiam means ”I will begin” and that is where we believe we are – at the forefront of a paradigm shift in metabolic disease treatment.

Most treatment options currently in development for metabolic disease focus on reduction of energy intake. Meabcos patenterede teknologiplatform tilbyder fordelagtige og immunomodulerende egenskaber.

Draupnir Bio is a Danish biotechnology company driven by a deep commitment to scientific excellence and the desire to bring innovative therapies to patients in need. By harnessing the natural machinery of the lysosome, we are developing oral, small molecule degraders of extracellular pathogenic proteins – the next frontier of targeted protein degradation (TPD), a rapidly emerging field that exploits a cell’s own destruction machinery to tackle disease-causing proteins that have historically been highly challenging to target with conventional therapies. First-generation TPD approaches are exclusively limited to intracellular targets, leaving extracellular and membrane-bound proteins – 40% of the human proteome – untouched. At Draupnir, we are extending the potential of TPD to both extracellular and membrane-bound proteins in a pioneering approach using our novel and differentiated, proprietary technology platform which targets lysosome receptors and has the potential to revolutionise the field of TPD.

Name: Synklino
Description:
Synklino is a clinical stage biotechnology company developing a first-in-class ex vivo therapy to improve kidney transplantation outcomes through better cytomegalovirus (CMV) prevention. CMV infection places transplant recipients at significant risk for complications and poorer clinical outcomes. 

Synklino's lead program, SYN002, is administered ex vivo during kidney perfusion, enabling direct treatment of the donor organ for CMV without exposing the transplant recipient to systemic therapy. The program is supported by peer-reviewed, preclinical proof-of-concept data in human donor kidneys, generated in collaboration with Professor Michael Nicholson at the University of Cambridge and Addenbrooke’s Hospital and published in the American Journal of Transplantation. Synklino retains broad intellectual property rights to SYN002 and its ex vivo use in organ perfusion.

A Phase 1 trial is currently ongoing to evaluate the safety, tolerability and exploratory efficacy of SYN002 across four dose-escalation cohorts of CMV-positive donor kidney recipients. The study is led by Professor Atul Humar – who is internationally recognised for his work in transplant infectious diseases, specialising in CMV prevention and treatment – at the Ajmera Transplant Centre, University Health Network (UHN), Toronto, one of the world's leading transplant centres.
