Name: Microbiome Health Initiative
Description:
Our gut microbiome plays a critical role in health and disease. The Novo Nordisk Foundation Microbiome Health Initiative explores how gut bacteria influence cardiometabolic health. The overall aim of MHI is to verify a causal connection between the human intestinal microbiome and diseases such as cardiovascular disease and diabetes.

Phase I, running from 2024 to 2028, focuses on collaborative research projects that investigate the specific effects of gut bacteria or metabolites and advance understanding on how microbiome interventions could reduce the risk of cardiometabolic diseases or help manage them.

The virtual research center, anchored at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), is lead by Professor Fredrik Bäckhed from the University of Gothenburg. Professor, and Head of The National Food Institute, Tine Rask Licht from DTU National Food Institute acts as the co-Director.

Other members of the research center are:

Martin Steen Mortensen, Head of Research Group for Gut, Microbes and Health at DTU

Henrik Roager, Associate Professor and Head of the Microbiome & Metabolomics research group at the Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports, at the University of Copenhagen

Name: Hoba Therapeutics
Description:
Hoba Therapeutics is a Danish biotech developing restorative treatments for chronic pain disorders and hearing loss. Both indications have a clear unmet medical need for safe and efficacious treatments for millions of patients worldwide. 

Hoba Therapeutics is developing HB-086 for the treatment of chronic neuropathic pain. HB-086 is a non-opioid compound with a unique mechanism of action targeting the peripheral nervous system to reverse neuropathic pain and the underlying cause of the disease. 

The second drug candidate HB-097 is a pharmacological treatment for sensorineural hearing loss. Preclinical data of HB-097 show both a preventive effect of hearing loss by protecting nerve cells and a regenerative effect by reversal of already induced damage.

Hoba Therapeutics was founded in 2016 by Novo Holdings and Borean Innovation. Hoba Therapeutics received the Accelerator grant from the European Innovation Council in 2021 and the Grand Solution grant from Innovation Fund Denmark in 2018.

About chronic neuropathic pain:
Chronic neuropathic pain is a significant global health issue, affecting a substantial portion of the population worldwide. In Europe, the prevalence is estimated to be 6–8%  of the general population. Chronic neuropathic pain represents an enormous personal and economic burden.

Neuropathic pain is a chronic disorder resulting from damage or dysfunction of the nervous system. Causative factors are lesions in or disorders of the nervous system, such as injury, pressure, toxic agents (e.g., chemotherapy), viral infections, and metabolic disorders. These lesions lead to aberrant functioning of sensory nerve cells, resulting in a chronic, debilitating sensation of pain.

The complexity and variability of chronic neuropathic pain necessitates a multifaceted treatment approach and highlights the need for a more effective and safer treatment options. The global neuropathic pain market is estimated to be valued at USD 7.6 bn.

Name: Skape Bio
Description:
Skape Bio is a biotechnology company harnessing Nobel Prize winning AI-powered protein design and synthetic biology to generate novel functional de novo designed modulators of integral membrane proteins.

Our cutting-edge computational platform integrates deep evolutionary insights with advanced protein design methodologies tailored specifically for integral membrane proteins, generating molecules with exceptional developability and function. Our proprietary experimental platform enables high-throughput screening directly in human cells, bypassing the need for target solubilization and unlocking previously inaccessible GPCRs. This approach has demonstrated broad applicability across GPCR families, successfully delivering novel agonists and antagonists.

Through de novo design, minibinders achieve precise control over target binding and possess biophysical properties that enable superior pharmacology, such as gut stability, potency, and selectivity, while offering a simpler manufacturing process compared to traditional antibodies. Skape Bio’s in-cell screening platform evaluates tens of thousands of designs in their natural cellular context, accelerating target-directed discovery and optimization for first- and best-in-class indications in oncology, inflammation, metabolic disease, and neurology. Our robust platform infrastructure also supports future active learning for improved AI-driven binder design.

In addition to its in-house discovery programs, Skape Bio actively seeks partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies to co-develop novel therapeutics and unique tool compounds.

Skape Bio is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, a spinout from the three-year “Modulate” collaboration between the BioInnovation Institute and the University of Washington’s Institute for Protein Design (IPD), founded and led by David Baker, recipient of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

Our flagship service, LS-JourneyTM, is a modular whole brain imaging platform combining iDISCO+ tissue clearing, light sheet fluorescence microscopy, and AI-assisted image analysis — delivering quantifiable, brain-wide results across 800+ anatomical regions for academic labs, biotech, and pharma teams worldwide. Compatible endpoints include c-Fos brain mapping, drug biodistribution, disease pathology quantification, and whole brain connectivity mapping.

All data is delivered interactively via CNS-VoyagerTM — our 3D virtual brain platform for integrative spatial biology. CNS-VoyagerTM allows researchers to explore whole brain imaging data alongside gene expression, connectivity, and neuronal activity datasets in one shared reference space, turning complex 3D datasets into actionable neuroscience insights. Vibraint combines deep scientific expertise with the scalable infrastructure needed to make whole brain imaging accessible to every neuroscientist.

Name: Xergi
Description:
Xergi designs and builds biogas plants. Based upon more than 30 years' experience, the company has developed plant concepts which are flexible, robust in their construction, reliable in operations, and easy to operate.

Xergi focuses on ensuring the customer gets maximum yield on investments. It is our experience that a high quality plant ensures stable operation and a high gas production.

As an active partner in all stages of the project, Xergi can assist with project development, dealing with relevant authorities, project design, procurement, construction, commissioning of the plant and its subsequent operation.

With more than 50 biogas plants as references, Xergi has built up a large field of expertise in all professional areas - including biology, chemistry, engineering physics, procurement and finance - necessary to ensure a successful biogas project.

Xergi always develops and implements its biogas projects based on local market conditions and legislation.

Our list of references includes biogas plants in the US, UK, France, Germany, Denmark and several other European countries.

Name: Kariya Pharmaceuticals
Description: Our mission is to develop first-in-class agents that will dramatically improve the lives of people living with Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

Name: European Protein A/S
Description:
European Protein is an innovative producer of fermented proteins tailored to enhance the health and productivity of pigs, poultry and aquaculture.

Founded in 2011, this family-owned company now delivers high-quality complementary proteins to farmers and feed producers worldwide through its three production facilities in Denmark, Ukraine, and the US.

At European Protein, we aspire to provide tomorrow’s solutions today. That’s why we invest in cutting-edge research to develop alternative protein solutions that contribute to our shared goal of promoting sustainability, efficiency and animal welfare. 

Read more about European Protein at www.europeanprotein.com

Name: Immunordic
Description:
Immunordic enables faster and more accessible discovery of high-quality protein binders for therapeutics, diagnostics, and advanced research tools.
Our proprietary platform combines in silico binder prediction with wet-lab validation to deliver functional minibinders and VHHs with reduced cost and turnaround time — typically 2–6 weeks — outperforming traditional discovery workflows.

Name: Fuse Vectors
Description: At Fuse Vectors, our mission is to revolutionize AAV gene therapy development. Traditional cell-based technologies have hindered progress, posing challenges in safety, efficacy, development time, and cost. Our Cell-Free AAV technology surpasses these methods, producing safer, more effective, and cost-efficient AAV viral vectors in a fraction of the time.

Name: Alcolase
Description: Is it possible to enjoy moderate amounts of alcohol when socializing, without risking your health? We believe it should be!

Name: BOOST Pharma
Description: BOOST Pharma is based on years of collaborative research from Karolinska Institute in Stockholm with the focus on novel cell therapy treatments for Osteogenesis Imperfecta. The research teams of associate professor Cecilia Götherström and professor Magnus Westgren have shown that that treatment with BOOST Cells greatly enhanced the quality of life for patients suffering from this otherwise extremely debilitating disease.

Name: AffinityAI
Description:
AffinityAI is an AI protein design company turning binder discovery from trial-and-error into deliberate design.

Generating a sequence that binds to a target is no longer the hard part. Designing a binder that is specific, functional, and developable, against the targets conventional discovery struggles to reach, is. That gap is where we work.

Our platform, Apex, designs binders to a defined epitope and validates them experimentally, delivering candidates with a clear picture of where and how they engage their target, across modalities including miniprotein Designerbodies, nanobodies, and peptides. From a single difficult target to a full design campaign, we help partners in pharma, biotech, diagnostics, and research move faster, and with more confidence in what they get back.

Founded by scientists behind landmark protein design research in Nature and Science, and grown out of one of the world's leading protein design laboratories.

Name: TetraKit Technologies
Description:
TetraKit Technologies (2021) is a spin-off company originating from the University of Copenhagen (KU). 

Our mission is to revolutionize theranostic agent development through our unique chemistry - The TetraKit Platform. It allows for one-fits-all radiolabeling of most targeting vectors with optimal diagnostic and therapeutic radionuclides. We develop both, our core platform technology, as well as proprietary novel theranostic radiopharmaceuticals based on our platform. This technology is based on the latest advancements in click chemistry and radiolabeling techniques coming from our laboratories.

We are interested in partnerships to combine our radiolabeling platform with emerging targeting vectors.

Name: omiics
Description:
Your ideal partner for front-end RNA research

The omiics core team has +40 years of combined expert knowledge within the field of transcriptomics, RNA sequence analysis and bioinformatics. This has resulted in more than 50 collaborative studies published in peer-revied journals, such as Nature, EMBO, Genome Biology and Nucleic Acid Research. Honed by our continued partnering in international projects within core-research areas, we offer cutting-edge knowledge and expertise.

At omiics, dedicated specialists tailor solutions specifically to your project, providing end-to-end support – from laboratory through bioinformatics to interpretation, on both standard services and R&D projects. 

Standard methods include: Total RNA sequencing, Small RNA sequencing, tRNA sequencing, digital PCR, NanoString, ONT, Exosome isolation, profiling, labelling and more.
Specialization in materials with ultra-low RNA content, including: Plasma, serum, CSF, bile, saliva, urine, dairy powder, culture media and more.

Name: June Bio
Description: We're a biotech startup based at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark. We are pioneering a scalable production of mucin glycoproteins to restore human mucosal health.

Name: Mikrolab - Frisenette A/S
Description:
Mikrolab – Frisenette A/S er en førende leverandør af laboratorieudstyr, forbrugsartikler og kemikalier.

Med 140 års samlet erfaring og over 100 leverandører tilbyder vi kvalificeret vejledning og løsninger inden for især laboratorieautomatisering og effektivisering af workflows. Hos os finder du alt fra pipetter og kolber til vandbade og fittings.

Name: NordicBlue ApS
Description: Nordic Blue is in the process of developing an eco-friendly alternative to denim dying, which will eliminate hazardous chemicals used in the production of synthetic indigo and in the dyeing process at the denim mills. We target to eliminate 80,000 tons of chemicals used for conventional denim dyeing.

Name: Delta Optical Thin Film A/S
Description:
Delta Optical Thin Film A/S is a world-leading manufacturer of optical thin film coatings with more than fifty years of experience. In the 1960s, Delta Optical Thin Film A/S pioneered optical monitoring techniques to control deposition.

With its unique and advanced optimisation software to match customers' particular optical specifications, Delta Optical Thin Film A/S ensures a fast and efficient design process.
 
Advanced optical coatings

In the early 1990s Delta Optical Thin Film A/S pioneered computer controlled optical monitoring and automatic deposition of advanced optical coatings, helping the world's leading manufacturers of analytical instruments in setting new standards.

Already in 2005, Delta Optical Thin Film A/S successfully managed to produce optical filters with the Ultra-Hard-Coated technology. Delta Optical Thin Film A/S has then led the way towards an ever increasing complexity and performance of optical filters.


Our product range comprises: 

Fluorescence Filter Sets
Continuously Variable Filters
Bandpass Filters: Single or Multiband, Laserline, Broadband
Dichroic Beamsplitters
Multiedge Dichroic Beamsplitters
Polarisation Beamsplitters
AOI Tolerant Dichroic Beamsplitters
Edge Filters: Long Wave Pass or Short Wave Pass
SMART Coatings: Multifunctional Filters


Our filters are found in many applications:

Hyperspectral Imaging 
Fluorescence microscopy
Spectroscopy
Wavelength selectors
High-performance monochromators
Biomedical laser systems
Point of Care (PoC) instruments
Image transferring systems
Colour separation systems
Optical coherence tomography

Name: Briota Technologies
Description:
Briota is an award winning MedTech company committed to innovating tech solutions for remote care, diagnostics and management for chronic respiratory conditions. Briota was established in February 2018 with a mission of democratization of lung health solutions for patients with moderate to severe asthma and COPD conditions. Our AI first approach aims to simplify the diagnostics and lifecycle management of Chronic Respiratory Ailments in a post Covid-19 world.
Briota’s innovative work in Prioritizing Care for Covid 19 patients using power of AI and ML has helped reduce Case Fatality Rate in patients with comorbidities. Government of India – Department of Science, BIRAC and Technology Development Board has funded R&D work of Briota. Briota’s Covid 19 Home Management service has benefitted over 15000 patients in Mumbai and currently is in implementation for over 40,000 workmen colony members in Tier II and Tier III cities like Renukoot, Hirakud, Utkal etc.

Name: ALS Odense (previously DB Lab)
Description:
ALS Odense (formerly DB Lab) performs chemical and microbiological analyses in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals to ensure your product's quality. Whether you are a large pharmaceutical company that only needs extra lab resources or a small biotechnical company with no lab facilities or in the herbal industry, we are there to help with our expertise. 
ALS Odense (formerly DB Lab) is a personal and competent business partner, and in collaboration with our customers we find the optimal and professional solution. As a fairly small contract organisation, we are a fast and flexible business partner.

Being a GMP lab, we work in accordance to the highest quality standards and meet all the regulatory requirements to ensure the quality of your product. ALS Odense (formerly DB Lab) provides quality assurance in all chemical and microbiological analyses including pharmacopoeia analyses. 

Delivery times are crucial to our customers and therefore of highest priority to us and continuous optimisation makes ALS Odense one of the most efficient suppliers of analyses on the market.

Name: BIO4Africa
Description: BIO4Africa is supporting the deployment of the bioeconomy in rural Africa by testing and adapting bio-based technologies that can create new sources of sustainable revenue for smallholder farmers and improve resilience to climate change. Funded by Horizon 2020

Name: Lophora
Description:
Lophora is a clinical-stage CNS drug discovery company developing novel, next-generation neuroplasticity inducing medicines to treat underserved mood and anxiety disorders.

www.lophora.com

Founded in 2018 Lophora has successfully finished initial characterization of its lead-candidate LPH-5 through funding granted by the BII (Novo Nordisk Foundation), public funds and experienced biotech investors. Lophora will initiate first-in-human trials by 2024.

Efficacy of LPH-5 has been extensively characterized in vivo and has successfully completed GLP-Tox with expected CTA submission by Q2 2024.

Name: Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Design
Description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Design at the University of Copenhagen tackles key challenges and grasps new opportunities in protein design by interfacing with the basic sciences – biology, chemistry, computer science, and physics – to advance fundamental understanding of protein structure and function, and to enable frontier protein design. Through an open and collaborative network of experts across these disciplines and other fields – such as biotechnology, medicine, and pharmacology – the CPD uses designed proteins to address challenges in healthcare and sustainability. The Center collaborates with local, national, and international partners from academia and industry to deliver world-leading research and training in fundamental and applied protein design.

The CPD is funded by an initial grant of 700M DKK for 7 years from the Novo Nordisk Foundation. At capacity, the CPD is anticipated to have about eight research groups, 70 researchers, and several support staff.

Name: Gefjon Pharma
Description:
Gefjon Pharma has developed a groundbreaking platform technology based on our unique hyper vesiculating outer membrane vesicle (OMV) technology. This combined with our unique extraction method enable high-yield cost-effective production of bio-industrials and therapeutics.  

Our first product is a revolutionary broad-protective bacterial E. coli vaccine targeting poultry production. We have PoC for both the vaccine and an aerosol application method. 

With E. coli being the single most important cause of mortality and infections in poultry, we will significantly reduce global consumption of antimicrobials, thereby minimizing  the development of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), improve animal welfare, and reduce CO2 emissions and food waste, while increasing customer profits. 

With our excellent customer relations and a strong demand for new vaccines, market entry barriers are low, and the potential is massive.

Name: Launch Bioindustries
Description: Launch Bioindustries is developing sustainable biomaterials through advanced fermentation. We focus on creating high-performance, eco-friendly alternatives to traditional materials, reducing environmental impact and supporting a circular economy. Driven by science and sustainability, Launch Bioindustries partners with industries to pave the way for a greener future.

Name: Curasight
Description:
Curasight is founded in 2013 in Denmark based on a strong understanding of nuclear medicines and more than a decade of research at Copenhagen’s University hospital, Rigshospitalet and the University of Copenhagen, where the potential of targeting the urokinase-type plasminogen activator receptor (uPAR) in solid cancer tumors was identified.

Led by Professor Andreas Kjær (CSO & Co-founder), the research demonstrated how uPAR could be used not only to visualize aggressive cancer biology through PET imaging, but also as a highly selective target for radionuclide therapy. These insights formed the basis for Curasight’s theranostic approach and the establishment of the company.

Since its establishment, Curasight has focused on advancing a uPAR-based platform combining diagnostic uPAR-PET imaging (uTRACE) and targeted radioligand therapy (uTREAT) to identify, target, and eliminate all types of aggressive solid tumors with unmatched precision.

Following its 2020 listing on Spotlight Market (~DKK 97 million raised), Curasight partnered uTRACE with Curium in 2023 for global development and commercialization within diagnosis of prostate cancer.

Through the years Curasight has conducted nine clinical trials (450 patients) with uTRACE in eight solid cancer types, demonstrating favorable biodistribution (precision) and safety data across solid tumors.

Curasight initiated its first Phase I uTREAT clinical trial in glioblastoma in 2025.

Name: Vipergen ApS
Description:
Vipergen is a world leading provider of small molecule drug discovery services based on DNA-encoded library (DEL) technologies.

Vipergen is finding tractable hits/leads for your pharmaceutical relevant targets, using three proprietary 2nd and 3rd generation DEL technologies.

Vipergen is offering different business models, including simple Fee-For-Service.

Recent News
- Copenhagen, Denmark, November 6th, 2020 - Commercial release of the first technology for DEL screening inside a living cell - Vipergen ApS announced today the commercial release of the first technology for screening of DNA-encoded small molecule libraries (DELs) inside a living cell. This proprietary technology will significantly accelerate and improve the drug discovery process. 

YoctoReactor – Technology platform for synthesizing DNA-encoded chemical libraries
•	100% match between the DNA-code and the synthesized small molecule is ensured by purification steps after each chemical reaction (unique capability) and use of robust chemistries

Binder Trap Enrichment – Technology platform for DEL screening in a homogeneous assay
•	As a homogeneous assay, BTE delivers high fidelity and a low false positive rate by avoiding surface artifacts and the complexity of matrix binding 
•	Instant specificity – multiplexed screening of target and anti-targets (unique capability)

Cellular Binder Trap Enrichment – Technology platform for DEL screening in a living cell
•	As an in vivo assay, cBTE delivers lower attrition rate (unique capability)
•	No need for purified active target protein – cBTE accommodates a broader target space  (unique capability)

Name: Mycoverse
Description:
Mycoverse delivers biologicals to agriculture, driving the transition from chemistry to biology in row crops. 

We combine our 3 strong technology pillars to deliver superior performing actives at unprecedented speed and cost:

1)	A unique fungal strain collection established over 40 years
2)	An AI driven high-throughput omics discovery platform
3)	State-of-the-art fungal production technology

Spinning out of the world-renowned Technical University of Denmark, DTU, and a founding team with 50+ years of combined expertise in metabolites, biologicals and agriculture.

Name: Nordic Virtual Pastures
Description: At NVP we are solving a key cost-pain of high volume cell growth. That is done by purifying biomass waste-streams from the industry to extract nutrients in a cost-effective and sustainable manner. Tailored and adapted to promote growth of various cells in large-scale bioreactor environments, greatly reducing production price of e.g., cultivated meat and antibody production.

Name: Swan Neck Bio
Description:
Swan Neck Bio helps food and biotech innovators unlock reliable, profitable biomanufacturing with DIRINOCTM — our storable, ready-to-use, quality-certified inoculum technology.

DIRINOCTM removes one of the biggest barriers in fermentation: seed preparation. By reducing contamination risks, improving predictability, and lowering waste, we give producers the confidence to scale with efficiency and profitability.

From lab to commercial production, we provide the inoculum solutions that de-risk development, accelerate time-to-market and enable sustainable growth.

Our vision is to be a leading enabler of the biosolutions urgently needed to restore planetary health.
Location: Tårnby, Capital Region Of Denmark, Denmark

Name: GlycoSpot
Description:
GlycoSpot is a Danish biotechnology company that develops application specific enzyme test methods that are fast to implement and easy to use. We help companies of all sizes to create better and more sustainable food & beverage products by transforming the way they work with enzymes.

This is possible thanks to our GlycoSpot Platform that is designed to make complex analysis faster and much simpler. No lab training is required to perform our high accuracy assays. We offer hassle-free solutions and deliver everything needed to run a test straight from the box. This is what we call the MINI-LAB by GlycoSpot Platform.

The MINI-LAB consists of an all-Inclusive lab-equipment tech-case, that in combination with our application specific Test-Kits, enables enzyme analyses, fast and easy anywhere by anyone.

Our Mission:
We innovate and market application-specific enzyme test methods that are fast to implement and easy to use.

Our Vision:
Become the leader within portable enzyme analysis

Name: ARTSMedia Denmark
Description:
ARTSMedia Denmark develops advanced culture media for Assisted Reproduction (ART).
Since 2020, we have been committed to delivering reliable, next-generation IVF media designed by scientists for scientists.

What sets us apart:

 Longest shelf life in the industry

 Extended quality control, including the Bovine Embryo Assay for unmatched reliability and consistency

 Dedicated customer service with direct access to our scientific team

 A lean, client-focused alternative to large bundled suppliers

Trusted by embryologists and distributors worldwide, ARTSMedia Denmark supports clinics with innovative tools to achieve the best outcomes in Assisted Reproduction.

 Learn more at www.artsmediadenmark.com and follow us here for updates and clinical insights.

Name: TRAITOMIC
Description:
Spun out from Carlsberg Research Laboratory's crop and microbial pursuits, Traitomic develops novel genetic traits across a diverse array of living organisms. 
 
The FIND-IT technology combines the largest populations ever made, with the world’s most efficient selection system, making us the fastest developer of new traits, 100% non-GM.

Traits are part of the solution to the biggest challenges in food, by enhancing yield, nutrition, flavor, and even processing. We believe nature’s rich diversity is the key in enabling us to help solve the world’s increasing food challenges.

As part of this commitment, TraitSource was launched, aiming to provide easy access to all our active libraries. TraitSource is a pioneering initiative by Traitomic aiming to empower the world of research in advanced crop trait development. New libraries are continuously added to TraitSource, increasing the potential for researchers in all fields. (https://www.traitsource.com)

Name: Clair Scientific
Description:
Jump-start your R&D with an affordable, versatile and easy-to-use microscope.  

Nebula can simultaneously image bright-field, phase contrast and 3D thickness maps, with full automation, and without any external PCs or displays.  

And it's much more affordable than you might think. Just check our website to receive an online quote within minutes, or to book a demonstration. 

Life science has never been this accessible.

Name: Blue Unit A/S - Stable Water Quality
Description:
Blue Unit is developing new technology to secure a stable water quality in recirculation fish farms and create optimal conditions for fish to grow.

Founded in Denmark in 2009 as a consultancy specializing in land-based fish farm water quality management, Blue Unit is an innovative Company founded on a practical fish farming tradition.

Practical fish farming knowledge is still central to the Blue Unit concept, where gathered water quality data is combined with professional support to help fish farmers better manage their fish farms.

Our Vision is to be the company that provides the best water quality measuring technology and to be recognized as giving the best professional advice for the fish farm industry. A farm manager needs to maximise the speed and quality of management decisions. In Blue Unit we understand that for achieving this there is a need to rely on good water quality measurements and to rapidly combine this with other useful fish farm data.

Please fell free to contact: 

info@blue-unit.com

Blue Unit A/S
Lumbyvej 11 b
5000 Odense
Denmark

CVR: 32 57 18 75

Name: Shimadzu Danmark
Description:
Velkommen til Shimadzu Danmark - din samarbejdspartner inden for analytisk Instrumentering! 
På vores hjemmeside træder du ind i en verden af banebrydende teknologi og innovative løsninger.
Vores brede spektrum af analyseinstrumenter er essentielle for forskning, udvikling og kvalitetskontrol i en række markedssegmenter, herunder fødevarer, pharma, miljø, kemisk, og meget mere. 
Fra avanceret gaskromatografi og væskekromatografi til ultrahurtig massespektrometri og Life Science laboratorieinstrumenter - vores sortiment er skræddersyet til at imødekomme dine behov og udfordringer. 
Udover vores avancerede produktudbud tilbyder vi også et omfattende udvalg af forbrugsvarer, analysestandarder, diagnostiske reagenskits og cutting-edge dataadministrations- og softwareløsninger. 
Med vores fokus på præcision, pålidelighed og innovation er Shimadzu Danmark din komplette partner inden for analytisk instrumentering. 
Træd ind i fremtidens laboratorieudstyr med Shimadzu Danmark - hvor videnskab og teknologi forenes for at skabe en bedre og mere effektiv verden. 
Velkommen til en verden af muligheder og eminent ekspertise hos Shimadzu Danmark!

Name: Tailwind Biotech
Description:
Tailwind Biotech is a synthetic biology company offering artificial DNA design services for improved strain engineering. We use proprietary artificial intelligence to help bioproduction-based companies achieve more effective and more efficient genetic engineering processes. Our technology designs optimized DNA sequences that help to maximize biological manufacturing yields while reducing development costs.

We believe that by leveraging the powerful mix of artificial intelligence and synthetic biology, we can accelerate advancements in healthcare, agriculture, sustainable energy and beyond.

Name: SOLID Therapeutics
Description: SOLID Therapeutics is an early-stage oncology company spun out of CBMR at the University of Copenhagen. We are developing novel cancer therapeutics with dual mode of action targeting both cancer cells and immune cells to treat solid tumors.

Name: Biomia ApS
Description: Biomia is a synthetic biology company developing a pipeline of plant-inspired natural or new-to-nature therapeutic products to address the unmet medical needs in pain, addiction, and mental health conditions.

Name: BioSense Solutions ApS
Description:
BioSense Solutions provides innovative and cost-effective solutions for monitoring and analysing microbial growth. 

Our automated brightfield imaging system, oCelloScope, enable microbiologists to perform super-sensitive, real-time, high-throughput monitoring of bacteria, yeast, mould and filamentous fungi.
With the powerful image analysis software, UniExplorer included with the oCelloScope you can perform automated Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing (AST) and MIC determination, monitor cell growth/inhibition, as well as microbial morphology analysis. All of this is done automatically, label-free, using standard microtiter plates from 6 to 96 wells.

BioSense Solutions – Makes microbiologic monitoring simple.

Name: Aida Oncology
Description: Cancer is a disease with millions of variations where even the most effective current treatment protocols will not work for many patients.  We at AIDA believe that modern high-performance computing and machine learning combined with cutting-edge gene reading tools can fast forward personalized cancer therapy and improve treatment options for cancer patients.

Name: Milky Way Biotech
Description:
Introducing Milky Way Biotech - a cutting-edge startup comprising a team of highly skilled researchers from the Technical University of Denmark. Our mission is to eradicate lactose intolerance through the development of a revolutionary single-pill genetic therapy. Currently, we are conducting pre-clinical studies to ensure the safety and efficacy of our treatment. We invite you to follow us on our website and social media platforms to stay up-to-date with our progress. Join us on our quest to make lactose intolerance a thing of the past!

 Admitted to European Venture Program (EVP) 2023 Summer
 Completed DTU Skylab Ignite Program 2023 Spring
 Completed KU Health Innovators Program 2023
 Funded by BioInnovation Institute (BII)

Name: MonTa Biosciences
Description:
MonTa Biosciences is a Clinical Stage Biotech Company with a vision to develop better cancer treatment for patients by utilizing the immune system to recognize and kill tumor cells – ultimately building an immune memory response that will protect the patient from metastatic disease.
Our clinical trial is running at sites in Denmark and Spain in patients with cutaneous and Uveal Melanoma with earlier response to immunotherapy
Read more about our study here: 
https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT04855435?term=mbs8&viewType=Card&rank=1

Name: Cbio A/S
Description:
Cbio A/S is a biopharmaceutical company developing next generation T-cell therapies against solid tumors. We are soon to enter our First-in-Human clinical study at Karolinska Hospital in Sweden with our proprietary T-cell product, novoleucel, where the T-cell are armed against oxidative stress.
We are located in Copenhagen, Denmark in a 1,000 m2 state-of-the-art facility where we develop and produce cell-based therapy products for clinical use.

Name: CHOSA Oncology
Description:
CHOSA Oncology is advancing precision medicine for platinum-based chemotherapy. Our patented Platin-DRP technology analyses 205 tumour-specific genes to predict which patients will benefit from cisplatin or carboplatin treatment before therapy begins.

By helping clinicians identify the right patients for platinum therapy, we aim to improve treatment outcomes, increase response rates, and reduce unnecessary toxicity. 

Supported by multiple clinical studies and Key Opinion Leaders, CHOSA is committed to setting a new standard in precision oncology and transforming how platinum chemotherapy is used.

Name: FermHub Zealand
Description:
FermHub Zealand er Danmarks største open access demo- og opskaleringsfacilitet med en kapacitet op til 5000L, og også Danmarks første målrettet biosolutions virksomheder. Vores kunder er både startups og etablerede virksomheder, der arbejder med fermentering og er kommet til næste fase i deres udvikling.
Vi etablerer et 3.000 kvm "state-of-the-art" teknologiplatform indenfor industrielt biofermenteringscenter til facilitering af start-ups, SMV'er o.lign., der skal opskalere, procesudvikle eller afprøve teknologier og idéer af fremtidens bæredygtige fødevarer samt andre relaterede biosolutions produktioner og produkter som f.eks. udstyrsleverandører og dataopsamlingsteknologier.
Dertil råder vi ligeledes over 2.200 kvm moderne kontor-, møde- og konferencefaciliteter, samt diverse testfaciliteter såsom laboratorie og laboratoriekøkken.
FermHub Zealand skal, udover at være førende indenfor grøn bioraffinering og mikrobiel biofermentering, også gå forrest når det gælder bæredygtighed, grøn omstilling og klimavenlig produktion. Stedet er ligeledes et væksthus for brancherelateret innovation og netværk. 
Vi samarbejder med en række lokale og nationale aktører - både offentlige og private samt landets universiteter og andre vidensinstitutioner - og vi er medlem af blandt andet Biotek Byen Kalundborg, Food & Bio Cluster og Nordic Circular Hubs, samt sidder med i flere forskellige udvalg, der alle arbejder for at fremme udviklingen indenfor Biosolutions og en grønnere fremtid indenfor specielt fødevareområdet.

Name: IntuBio
Description:
IntuBio is a biotechnology company dedicated to providing "Rapid Microbial Methods." Our innovative solutions are designed to enhance the efficiency of manufacturing and ensure the swift, safe release of products in healthcare, personal care, consumer care, and the food industry. 
As a trusted partner in quality control microbiology, we help our customers improve and save lives. 

To make this vision live, we have developed IntuGrow technology. This combination of hardware and software enables rapid microbial analysis, allowing for the detection and quantification of microbes in hours from sampling to result. The software automatically counts the colonies and provides image material for superior documentation and comprehensive data analysis.

Our aim is to significantly improve microbiological monitoring through rapid microbial analysis, empowering labs and manufacturing with advanced technology. 

IntuGrow solutions are embraced by leading companies in the pharmaceutical, food, and chemical industries.

Name: VAR2 Pharmaceuticals
Description: VAR2 Pharmaceuticals is a biotechnology company developing first-in-class therapeutics targeting oncofetal Chondroitin Sulfate, a group of pan-cancer, tumor-specific glycosaminoglycans discovered by us in 2012 and holding promise of treating many different types of cancer.

Name: SAXOCON A/S
Description:
SAXOCON A/S is a consulting company working with the medical device, pharmaceutical, and healthcare industries. We offer toxicological and safety assessments of chemical compounds in pharmaceuticals, food, medical devices, cosmetics and chemicals.

SAXOCON uses computer-based toxicological methods that make it possible to assess the safety of organic  compounds without the use of animal testing.

SAXOCON is a private company partly owned by Technical University of Denmark (DTU).

Name: FermBiotics
Description:
FermBiotics is a human health and microbiome focused company developing natural fermented seaweed and plant products for supporting gut health. FermBiotics’ vision is to produce fermented plant and seaweed products as food ingredients, dietary supplements and medical foods.
We combine prebiotics, probiotics and bioactives – a new category of food ingredients and dietary supplements we call FermBiotics. We have gained knowledge from microbiome studies combined with hands on knowledge of fermentation production.

Name: GlyProVac
Description:
GlyProVac has via its proprietary platform technology, BEMAP, discovered that 1) O-linked protein glycosylation is a surprisingly abundant post translational modification in bacterial, 2) glycoproteins are linked to increased immunogenicity. 
GlyProVac aim to be the first to explore and exploit this novel class of antigens as candidates for vaccine development. The GlyProVac lead YghJ/SslE/AcfD is a conserved protein with a known biological function and has vaccine potential not only in ETEC but also in UPEC. Using BEMAP, GlyProVac has identified 59 glycosylated residues in YghJ. We are in the PoC phase and currently work to establish that glycosylated YghJ elicit a more protective immune response compared to the non-glycosylated version.

Name: Holm & Halby A/S
Description:
Holm & Halby er en af Danmarks førende udbydere af laboratorieudstyr, med markedets stærkeste udvalg af laboratorieudstyr og fokus på hver enkelt kundes behov.

Holm Halby forhandler og servicerer laboratorieudstyr til forskning på laboratorier inden for farmaceutisk industri, hospital samt højere læreanstalter. Med mere end 60 år i branchen er vi Danmarks mest erfarne leverandør af laboratorieudstyr.

Name: DeepCyte
Description: DeepCyte is a stealth techbio company developing predictive products for toxicology using world-leading single-cell metabolomics technology.

Name: Cell Biotech International A/S
Description:
Cell Biotech is a global probiotic specialist, headquartered in South Korea with a dedicated European sales office in Denmark. We develop and produce clinically documented probiotic solutions for the dietary supplement industry.

Whether you are a contract manufacturer looking to add probiotics to your production capabilities, or a supplement brand exploring your first probiotic product - we make it simple.

What we offer: → Probiotic raw materials and premixes → Finished goods (ready-to-market products) → Full OEM & ODM solutions → Conceptual selling: ready-made probiotic concepts backed by clinical data.

Every strain in our portfolio is supported by clinical documentation. We combine deep R&D expertise with flexible European partnerships to help you bring probiotics to market faster.

Name: Eurofins Steins Laboratorium
Description: Eurofins Steins is part of the world leading food and feed testing laboratory group Eurofins Scientific. We establish the safety, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of food.

Name: EDGE Biotechnologies
Description:
EDGE Biotechnologies empowers biotech, pharmaceutical, and industrial-bio teams with real-time, single-molecule insight - shining a flashlight into the molecular “black box.” 

Our BIQ (Biomolecular Imaging & Quantification) platform fuses high-content imaging with AI analytics to expose hidden heterogeneity and turn it into actionable engineering leverage.

Biology First, AI Amplified: Direct observation of binding kinetics, conformational shifts, and rare events guides every decision; AI turbocharges your hypotheses.

Flashlight into Complexity: Move beyond end-point averages - watch millions of molecules interact live and quantify their behaviors in minutes, not months.

BIQ as a Team Sport: Unite scientists, engineers, and data experts with a shared data language, embedding BIQ across your Stage-Gate workflows and breaking down silos from bench to board.

From Plateau to Moat: Build a proprietary competitive edge as your BIQ datasets compound over time—creating a data moat no late adopter can breach.

Delivered via flexible BIQ Centers of Excellence—centralized or on-site—our services slash feedback loops, accelerate discovery, and future-proof your R&D operations. 

Founded on a decade of University of Copenhagen research, EDGE is your partner for continuous innovation.

Let us EDGE it! - together. Join us to illuminate the unseen and co-create the next era of molecular R&D ground up - one molecule at a time!

Name: SymbioMatch
Description: Our technology identifies optimal plant–microbe synergies to produce natural region- and crop-specific formulations.

Name: IBIS - Initiative for Biofertilizer Innovation and Science
Description:
IBIS – Initiative for Biofertilizer Innovation and Science is a global research collaboration dedicated to driving innovation and advancing biofertilizer solutions for sustainable agriculture. 
Our vision is to enable sustainable and affordable crop productivity worldwide by accelerating the discovery, development, and adoption of effective biofertilizers. We bridge the gap between laboratory research and real-world field application through standardized protocols, benchmark datasets, and open-innovation frameworks.
With core partners from DTU, Københavns Universitet - University of Copenhagen, Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (India), the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) (South Africa), and a growing network of collaborators, IBIS is building regional R&D hubs combining expertise in agronomy, fermentation technology, and data-driven modeling. Together, we will create an R&D Development Pipeline that provides access to cutting-edge equipment, validated protocols, and globally shared benchmark datasets — supporting the entire biofertilizer development process from discovery to field trials.
IBIS supports public and private stakeholders through the Open-Innovation-in-Science (OIS) program,  with calls on “Key Foundational Questions”, “Key Technology Challenges”, and “Case Studies”, to close knowledge gaps and develop biofertilizer leads.
We are also committed to education and capacity building, developing courses for academics, regulators, and future biofertilizer entrepreneurs, to advance biofertilizer R&D and implementation worldwide.
Our work empowers scientists, innovators, and farmers alike — fostering standardized, data-rich, and scalable biofertilizer solutions that contribute to global food security and sustainable agricultural systems.
IBIS is hosted at the Technical University of Denmark, Department of Biotechnology and Biomedicine, and funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and the Gates Foundation.

Name: CytoVac AB
Description:
Cytovac has the key to immunotherapy

Cytovac is a growing Danish biotech company, focusing on development of a cancer treatment that uses the body’s own immune system.

Promising results gained by the dedicated research team over a number of years, have brought about the development of the ALECSAT therapy. ALECSAT is a therapy based on injection of activated cells from the immune system. These cells will attack the cancer cells and activate the immune system in the patients. As Cytovac solely apply the patient’s own cells, this therapy is gentle and without the serious side effects normally associated with cancer treatment.

Cytovac has been granted Orphan Drug Designation by the European (EMA) as well as the American (FDA) medicines agencies in support to the company’s brain-cancer project.

Cytovac has generated convincing data with the ALECSAT treatments in three clinical phase I trials targeted at treatment of prostate cancer, pancreatic cancer and brain cancer. So far more than 100 cancer patients have been treated, with more than 250 doses of ALECSAT.

So Cytovac has a platform that may prove to be an efficacious treatment for several types of cancer. Cytovac has since 2015 concentrated all clinical efforts on brain cancer, and here the company is currently conducting clinical phase II trials.

Cytovac is dedicated to treatment of cancer by using our key to immunotherapy.

Name: MAGic-MOLFUN
Description:
The MAGic-MOLFUN doctoral network (DN) will train the next generation of specialists to transform natural products research. 

The next generation of specialists will be educated in a combination of wet-lab and computational skills to integrate genome mining and metabolomics with cutting-edge pathway discovery- and engineering approaches. There is a fast-growing demand for these combinations of skills, but these are rarely taught in current integrated training programs. These multidisciplinary skills and qualifications will be acquired while achieving the scientific goals of the program, namely understanding and developing the complex biosynthesis and production of microbial NPs for cross-sector applications such as medicine, food, agriculture, or biotechnology. Specifically, the Doctoral Candidates (DCs) will work in three areas:

    1) develop novel computational tools and algorithms to improve the identification and prediction quality of biosynthetic gene clusters encoding NP biosynthesis in genomic data. This genome-centered approach is complemented by
   2)  the use of cheminformatics approaches to link metabolomics data of NPs with the genomic data of the producers, which will greatly improve the compound discovery and dereplication process. These two data-centric approaches will finally
    3) converge into experimental applications that discover and characterize novel NPs with promising bioactivities (e.g., antibiotics, pre-/probiotics, agrichemicals, bio-pigments).

The scientific training program is complemented by a comprehensive transferable skill training that will equip the DCs for todays’ demands of a successful career in industry and academia. The skills obtained in the DN will enable the DCs to work not only in natural product research but also many other data-intensive areas of biotechnology.

“This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 101072485”.

Name: Typo Foods
Description:
Typo Foods brings new flavor to the forefront and looks beyond being a meat alternative. Without being tied to traditions, we open up a new food category exciting the palate, and delivering food experiences that go beyond the ordinary. Typo Foods is delivering a tasty and healthy yeast protein ingredient with the potential to deliver a range of superior food experiences to the global consumer. 

Based on a well-known food strain we use cutting edge biotechnology and food science to achieve best in class texture, flavor and nutrition profile of our products, without any additives.

Name: Cytoki Pharma
Description:
Cytoki Pharma is a privately held Danish clinical stage biotechnology company pioneering a new class of medicines that harness IL-22 biology to drive improved outcomes for metabolic disease and IBD.

NOTE: We are not currently recruiting and communication is always through an official Cytoki Pharma email address (from the @cytokipharma.com domain)
Location: Gladsaxe, Capital Region Of Denmark, Denmark

Name: Global Clinical Research Institute (GCRI)
Description:
Standing at the forefront of lower extremity research, Global Clinical Research Institute (GCRI) is a Contract Research Organization (CRO) that brings unparalleled expertise to wound care trials. GCRI’s offering is to provide operations management in supporting groundbreaking phase I-IV clinical studies that push the boundaries of medical science. 

Our elite team of wound care experts collaborates with world-renowned Principal Investigators and influential Key Opinion Leaders to help drive breakthroughs in patient care. With an unwavering commitment and dedication to our customers, at GCRI we aim to drive the clinical trials of our customers toward successful outcomes, and in doing so, support the delivery of revolutionary therapies to the patient.

Name: PanCryos | Currently undergoing restructuring
Description:
PanCryos is currently undergoing restructuring.

The underlying scientific work and intellectual property continue to inform next-generation approaches in beta-cell therapy.

For inquiries, please contact: dr.jackieameri@gmail.com

Name: Avilex Pharma ApS
Description: Ischemic stroke is the second leading cause of death and a major cause of disability. Avilex Pharma investigates a novel principle in treatment to meet this major unmet medical need.

Name: Inverna Therapeutics
Description:
Inverna Therapeutics is a Danish biotech company, founded in 2024 emerging from Southern Danish University in Odense, nurtured by Argobio Studio, a launch platform for Europe’s best medicinal science and supported by a world-class Scientific Advisory Board.
With our proprietary drug discovery platform, we're dedicated to developing transformative RNA therapeutics based on precision RNA splicing modulation. Our unique technology allows us to design, test, and develop highly specific activators of pseudo-exons in disease-relevant target RNA.
Today, we are pursuing breakthroughs in neurological disorders such as Parkinson’s disease, somatic repeat expansion diseases, and Huntington’s disease, knowing that the approach can extend to other organ systems and diseases.

Name: Biomcare
Description:
Biomcare is a microbiome intelligence partner for soil, plant, and animal systems - supporting growers, advisors, product teams, and research organisations. 

We help teams reduce biological uncertainty before major field, validation, or scale commitments are made.

Our focus is strengthening the biological decision layer behind crop programs, animal studies, product development, and regenerative transitions.

Biomcare combines microbiome profiling, whole genome sequencing, bioinformatics, and fit-for-purpose statistics to:

	•	Clarify variability across fields, facilities, and seasons
	•	Detect pathogen and functional signals early
	•	Strengthen documentation and mode-of-action understanding
	•	Reduce misallocated R&D and input spend
	•	Accelerate confident scale, stop, or adjustment decisions

In soil and plant systems, we map biological context in fields, rotations, and trials - helping teams separate true performance from environmental effects and hidden disease pressure.

In animal systems, we link microbiome dynamics to resilience, performance, and risk - supporting high-cost validation programs and commercial decision processes.

Biomcare does not replace agronomy, veterinary science, R&D, or microbiology.
We strengthen the analytical and interpretive layer that makes their work clearer, more comparable, and decision-ready.

Earlier stop when needed.
Faster scale when justified.
Stronger documentation when required.

Name: Kripthonite Therapeutics
Description: Kripthonite Therapeutics is a preclinical biotech company that develops a therapy that eliminates oxygen-depleted cancer cells in solid tumors. Oxygen-depletion heightens the most aggressive features of cancers and  results in resistance towards radiation and immuno- and chemotherapy. Our therapy derails energy metabolism in oxygen-depleted cancer cells, leading to rapid and selective cancer cell killing.

Name: CultiXcell A/S
Description:
CultiXcell A/S is a Danish company specializing in bioprocess optimization and the implementation of Process Analytical Technology (PAT). Our end-to-end solutions include sales, installation, qualification, and ongoing support - for both our own and partner-supplied measurement technologies.

We serve R&D and production across industries including pharma, biotechnology, brewing, cell-based food, and carbon capture.

Our expertise covers spectrometry, biomass probes, cell counting, and advanced fermenter and gas conditioning systems. We help improve data quality, reduce manual work through online monitoring and control, and optimize bioprocesses with mammalian, microbial or filamentous cells. In tablet manufacturing, we enable compliance with FDA and EU Pharmacopeia requirements by integrating PAT into batch and continuous processes, optimizing key steps towards continuous manufacturing with real-time release testing.

Name: Treat Systems
Description:
TREAT Systems is a research-driven software company with a strong clinical understanding, dedicated to developing advanced solutions for antimicrobial stewardship.

Our mission is clear: to improve the quality of care for patients with infections – while safeguarding the effectiveness of antibiotics for future generations.

We combine deep expertise in both the clinical and technical aspects of infection management with innovative product development that creates value for patients, clinicians, hospitals, and society.

We focus on two main products:

TREAT Lab – designed to support clinical microbiologists in diagnostics, surveillance, and optimization of antibiotic policies.

TREAT Essential – an AI-powered clinical decision support system that helps infectious disease specialists and emergency physicians make rapid, accurate antibiotic treatment decisions.

Proven results from recent studies show that TREAT Essential can:
- Improve empiric antibiotic therapy
- Reduce mortality in patients with severe infections
- Increase guideline compliance
- Reduce the use of WHO “Watch” antibiotics

Beyond developing cutting-edge software, we actively participate in clinical studies and collaborate with hospitals and research institutions worldwide. Our goal is not only to create tools, but to deliver solutions that make a real difference in the fight against antimicrobial resistance.

Name: dawn-bio
Description:
dawn-bio is a biotechnology company dedicated to advancing treatments for the millions of people silently struggling with infertility.
With our groundbreaking platform technology - a human stem cell-based embryo and implantation model – we are uniquely equipped to discover and develop molecules that enhance healthy live births in IVF.

Today, IVF clinics choose the best embryos.  With dawn-bio, they will be able to change their trajectory for the better.

Name: Mello
Description:
The educated audience is seeking clean-label, science-backed products that deliver real benefit, as well as support sustainability and provide convenience. With the single-ingredient market oversaturated, demand is shifting toward holistic solutions such as gut-brain blends. To stand out, Brands are focusing on all-in-one offerings that integrate seamlessly into end-users’ wellness routines. For this, they need a sophisticated technology like Mello's.

We've developed a novel approach to micro-encapsulate actives in liquid or suspension, with a patented TrueCore-Shell (TCS) process that effectively generates a liquid-in-solid structure. This is what makes us stand apart from others - we can suppress unappealing taste and odour, enhance solubility and stability, and modify release and delivery of actives requiring gastric protection for Customers across Food, Wellness, Beauty and Pharma, globally.

Name: TriptoBIO
Description:
TriptoBIO is developing a platform for producing natural plant compounds that will support the health of our planet.

Our goal is to create a future where everyone can benefit from the power of plants, without depleting natural resources.

We are applying cutting-edge synthetic biology techniques to produce a class of plant compounds, called diterpenoids, via fermentation.

This will enable novel applications of plant diterpenoids and revolutionize a range of industries - while avoiding intensive plant farming and petrochemicals.

Our first product will liberate the world from rat poison, by supporting safe rat sex.
